title: Creative Director
description:
Ibotta is seeking a
**Creative Director**
to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. As Creative Director, you will shape how the world sees Ibotta as a leading technology company, elevating our look and feel across all enterprise marketing and communications while ensuring on-time delivery and efficient operations.
  
  
You will lead our creative studio to develop distinctive brand assets and impactful campaigns that build Ibotta's awareness and grow advertising revenue in the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, creative excellence, and team leadership to drive our brand's impact and growth. This leader will be expected to have proficiency in design, copywriting, or video production, and will be asked to roll up their sleeves as a practitioner to guide execution and help the team produce exceptional work.
  
  
This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.
  
  
**Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.**
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build corporate brand identity and creative guidelines for Ibotta to show up visually and experientially across every touchpoint with distinction.
* Lead and mentor a diverse team of creative professionals across design and production, fostering a culture of proven concept, craft, and collaboration while ensuring consistent creative execution.
* Partner closely with product, analytics, marketing, and leadership teams to drive brand consistency and elevate Ibotta's market presence.
* Help translate complex product offerings, data, and value propositions into clean, engaging creative concepts.
* Establish and optimize operational processes to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability of creative output.
* Lead creative reviews, provide actionable feedback, and foster a culture of craft, curiosity, and innovation.
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, articulating creative vision and strategy clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Manage team health, resource planning, and talent strategy, ensuring the right capabilities, skills, and staffing are in place to meet business needs.
* Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience as a hands-on creative with a proven track record across diverse media (agency and in-house). In-house experience is strongly preferred.
* 4+ years of experience leading creative teams in dynamic, fast-growing companies, ideally with a B2B / tech focus.

**About The Role**
The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high-fidelity consumer experiences.
  
  
Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.

Experience Strategy:

* Consumer-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.

**Connected Fan Experiences**

* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end-to-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.

* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.

**Experience Innovation & Data Informed Design**

* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next-generation interaction models, including AI-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real-time sports feed integrations.
* Data-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

**Your Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world-class, large-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling & Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

**About Electronic Arts**
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Director, AI Creative (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
Forbes Advisor is hiring a Director, AI Creative to design and implement how the Creative team uses AI to improve the quality and the quantity of our work across our social verticals. As this is a new department within the Creative team, you will define its function, build the systems that run it, and hire and oversee the required team. The ideal candidate has deep expertise spanning generative AI and tooling, direct response creative, and leadership of creative teams. You and your team will work across Forbes’ portfolio of verticals, partnering with Creative Directors who own end-to-end vertical creative strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design the strategy, team structure, and systems for embedding AI tools in the creative process, with a focus on producing a high volume of generative AI content designed for paid social creative.
* Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it.
* Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them.
* Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run.
* Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in creative, production, or content, with at least the last 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production. You have stood up an AI capability inside a creative org before.
* A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built, and you can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative tools: image models that can hold several characters consistent, AI video both with and without native audio, lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on the trade-offs, not a list of tool names.
* You architect the tooling. You can map out the systems and automations the team needs, build working versions yourself in tools like n8n, Gumloop, or Make, and brief engineering clearly enough that they can build the rest.
* Experience leading people or a function, whether as a manager, a team lead, or the person who built a capability others came to depend on. You can make the case for a hire and then hold the bar you set.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails: regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, and partner brand guardrails.
* Clear written communication, and the confidence to hold your position with senior people outside Creative, including the buyers and the executive team.
* Comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools, and sometimes the plan, change under you.

****STRONG PLUSES****

* Video editing or motion and VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of forming a real point of view on brand-new tools fast, because these tools turn over monthly.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**
  Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: Head of Creative Services

description:

At TOAST, we believe
**experience is everything**
.

We Want
  
  
We’re looking for an experienced, highly organised Head of Creative Services to lead the day-to-day management, resourcing and development of TOAST’s global creative team.

You’ll also take responsibility for the management and development of our creative people, working alongside our Creative Director and discipline leads to support performance, progression and a strong creative culture. * Support recruitment and onboarding. Work with leadership and discipline leads to identify future hiring requirements. Support recruitment, interviews and onboarding, ensuring new team members are introduced effectively into the business and our ways of working.
* Improve creative services operations. Provide leadership with a clear view of capacity, utilisation, freelance commitments and future resource needs. Develop simple, effective systems for resourcing, scheduling, onboarding and collaboration across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

title: Creative Director - Matchnode digital health marketing agency
description:
**Position Objective**
----------------------

The Creative Director leads creative strategy and execution for Matchnode’s paid social and digital direct response campaigns, with a focus on digital health and healthcare clients. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can turn audience insights into compelling advertising, guide a creative team, and use performance data to improve results.

The role connects creative decisions to client growth: qualified patient acquisition, completed appointments, customer acquisition, and revenue, depending on each client’s business model. Success requires strong concepts, clear copy, effective production, and a disciplined testing process that balances conversion performance with brand credibility and patient trust.

**About Matchnode**
-------------------

Matchnode is a digital marketing agency focused on paid media, performance creative, and measurable growth, with a focus on digital health and healthcare. We help clients connect with the people they serve through clear messaging, disciplined testing, and campaigns tied to business outcomes. The Creative Director leads the creative work that makes those campaigns effective.

 **Requirements**  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

**1. Paid Social and Direct Response Strategy -**
-------------------------------------------------

* Own creative strategy for paid social, with Meta and Instagram as core channels and TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels as client needs require.
* Translate client growth goals, patient or customer research, funnel data, and competitive insights into creative briefs, campaign concepts, messaging angles, offers, and calls to action.
* Develop distinct concepts for different audience needs and levels of awareness, from introducing a care option to helping someone take the next step toward an appointment.
* Build creative roadmaps that balance new concepts with iterations of proven work. Partner with paid media to prioritize tests based on business impact, available spend, and production capacity.
* Extend winning messaging into landing pages and other conversion assets so the experience from ad to action is clear and consistent.

**2. Creative Development and Production**
------------------------------------------

* Direct and contribute to ad copy, scripts, storyboards, static ads, carousels, motion graphics, and short-form video. Stay close enough to the work to write, edit, and solve execution problems.
* Lead development of creator-led content, clinician explainers, product demonstrations, and approved patient stories or testimonials when appropriate.
* Create platform-native advertising with strong openings, clear benefits, credible proof, and specific next steps. Adapt pacing, framing, captions, and formats to each placement.
* Give actionable feedback to designers, copywriters, editors, creators, and production partners. Maintain quality from initial concept through final delivery.

**Creative Director Responsibilities -**
----------------------------------------

**1. Testing and Performance Improvement**
------------------------------------------

* Partner with paid media and analytics to run a structured creative testing program. Define the hypothesis, audience insight, primary variable, and success criteria before production.
* Review performance at the concept, message, format, and asset level. Use attention and click metrics as diagnostic signals alongside conversion rate, cost per qualified acquisition, and downstream outcomes.
* Distinguish creative findings from changes in spend, targeting, landing pages, attribution, or patient intake. Avoid declaring winners from limited or misleading data.
* Turn results into clear recommendations: what to scale, what to revise, what to stop, and what to test next. Document learnings so they inform future work across the team.
* Monitor fatigue and maintain a steady pipeline of fresh concepts and useful variations that supports client growth.

**2. Health Messaging and Patient Trust**
-----------------------------------------

* Translate complex health services into clear, empathetic language that helps people understand their options and take an informed next step.
* Account for barriers such as stigma, cost, insurance coverage, access, eligibility, and uncertainty about care. Use client-verified information when describing services and outcomes.
* Build client clinical, legal, and compliance reviews into the production workflow. Route claims, testimonials, disclosures, and sensitive messaging to the appropriate reviewers before launch.
* Avoid unsupported outcome claims, guarantees, stigmatizing language, or copy that assumes a viewer has a health condition. Follow client requirements and applicable advertising platform policies.
* Use only approved materials and permissions for patient stories and health information. Keep sensitive client and patient information out of unapproved creative and AI tools.

**3. Client Collaboration and Team Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead creative discovery, concept presentations, and performance reviews. Explain the audience insight, creative rationale, and proposed test in language clients can evaluate.
* Partner with account management, which leads overall account coordination, and paid media, which leads media strategy and buying. Own creative recommendations, quality, and delivery.
* Coach internal creatives and external partners, set clear standards, and develop their ability to connect craft with measurable outcomes.
* Manage briefs, feedback, approvals, workload, and production schedules across accounts. Flag scope changes and resource constraints early; deliver within agreed hours, budgets, and deadlines.
* Use AI and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, variations, and production where appropriate, with human review for accuracy, originality, brand fit, and sensitive content.
* Support new business and account growth through relevant concepts, case studies, and creative recommendations. Help leadership scope and price creative work realistically.

**Qualifications -**
--------------------

* 7+ years of relevant creative experience, including experience leading creative teams or creative workstreams for paid social and digital direct response campaigns.
* A portfolio of paid social work that demonstrates strong concepts, copy, and execution, with examples of testing, iteration, and measurable acquisition or conversion results. Be prepared to explain your role and the limits of the data.
* Experience marketing digital health, healthcare, or other sensitive or regulated consumer services. Ability to work effectively with clinical and compliance reviewers.
* Deep understanding of Meta and Instagram creative, short-form video, creator content, and direct response fundamentals. Experience with Facebook, TikTok or YouTube is valuable.
* Strong copywriting and creative direction skills, with the ability to shape hooks, offers, proof points, scripts, and landing page messaging.
* Ability to interpret advertising and funnel performance, develop testable hypotheses, and turn findings into specific creative decisions.
* Experience leading designers, editors, writers, freelancers, and production partners while managing multiple clients and deadlines.
* Confident client presentation skills and a practical understanding of agency scopes, production budgets, capacity, and profitability.
* Working familiarity with design, video editing, collaboration, and AI tools, with sound judgment about when and how to use them.

**Measures of Success -**
-------------------------

Goals will be set by account and reviewed with agency leadership. Performance is evaluated through both creative execution and contribution to client results, in partnership with paid media and account management.

* Creative contribution to qualified acquisition, conversion rates, acquisition cost, and other agreed business outcomes.
* A consistent testing cadence that produces useful learning and new concepts that can sustain or improve performance.
* On-time delivery, efficient approval cycles, and work completed within agreed scope and production budgets.
* Client confidence in creative recommendations, strong collaboration, and contribution to client retention.
* Team development, reliable quality standards, and effective use of internal and external resources.

**Location and Working Relationships -**
----------------------------------------

This position is remote, with attendance at Matchnode company events several times a year and occasional travel for client meetings, production, or business development. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

Reports to the agency’s designated executive leader. Works closely with the Head of Media, Head of Accounts, account managers, media buyers, analytics partners, and internal and external creative professionals.

**Salary -**
------------

Up to $200,000 annual salary

 **Benefits**

* **Health Insurance:** Employer contribution of approximately $250–$500 per month, depending on the plan selected
* **401(k) Plan:** Eligible to participate immediately on the date of hire. Company matches the first 3% contributed by employee.
* **Educational Stipend:** Up to $1,000 annually for approved learning expenses.
* Company retreats to cool places!

title: Associate Creative Director
description:
World Vision is hiring an Associate Creative Director to serve in the Marketing Division.
  
  
AT A GLANCE
  
**Role:** Associate Creative Director
  
**Reports to:** Senior Creative Director
  
**Location:** Remote
  
**Required Experience:** In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required.
  
**Preferred Experience:** Prior people-management experience is preferred. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S.A for any employer.
  
**Travel:** Up to 10% of the time.
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
THE JOB
  
Lead creative development, storytelling, and brand expression within World Vision’s internal advertising agency. Partner with senior leadership to translate fundraising and audience strategies into integrated, multichannel campaigns, with an emphasis on writing and messaging. Guide assigned team members, set priorities, and oversee quality and delivery to strengthen brand awareness and produce measurable results. Carry out World Vision’s Christian mission, vision, and strategies, witnessing to Christ and ministering to others through life, deed, word and sign.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Keep Christ central in individual and corporate life. Actively participate in and contribute to the spiritual disciplines of the organization (Christian conduct, chapel, prayer, worship, devotions and leadership of devotions); incorporate WV Core Values into decisions within scope of role.
* Lead assigned brand and fundraising campaigns from strategic brief through final delivery, translating audience insight and organizational objectives into integrated creative concepts, messaging, and multichannel experiences.
* Serve as the lead creative and conceptual partner for assigned work, developing campaign narratives, concepts, messaging frameworks, calls to action, and creative solutions across direct response, digital, social, video, experiential, print, email, web, and emerging platforms.
* Establish project-level creative direction, goals, priorities, and quality expectations for assigned writers, designers, freelance partners, and cross-disciplinary teams; monitor progress and resolve difficult but typically non-complex execution, resource, and stakeholder issues.
* Review work in progress and final deliverables for strategic alignment, brand voice, creative quality, accuracy, accessibility, channel requirements, budget, and timelines; provide clear, actionable feedback and approve work within delegated authority.
* Partner with peers, the Senior Creative Director, and cross-functional partners to clarify briefs, align expectations, allocate resources, and deliver cohesive creative solutions.
* Present creative concepts and rationale to clients and senior stakeholders, synthesize feedback, and guide the team toward effective solutions.
* Supervise assigned professional employees and creative personnel, including setting goals and objectives, assigning work, coaching performance, supporting development, and contributing to talent decisions.
* Support a client-centric in-house agency model through strong service standards, collaboration, processes, and consistent policies.
* Use performance data, audience feedback, testing results, and emerging tools to improve work.
* Maintain awareness of corporate goals, objectives, organizational announcements, and activities. Reference and follow organizational policies and procedures, seeking clarity as needed.

YOU BRING THESE SKILLS
  

* Creative thinking, storytelling, concept development, and strong oral and written communication, including fluent English and persuasive messaging that motivates donors and prospects.
* Advanced marketing and branding knowledge and graphic design fundamentals, supported by fundraising knowledge and an understanding of global events and World Vision’s mission and priorities.
* Strategic orientation and planning: Translating organizational goals into creative strategies and practical short- and long-range plans across work units.
* Implementation and project management: build production plans, identify resources, balance competing priorities, and manage milestones, costs, and delivery.
* Team building, people management, collaboration, and relationship building set clear expectations, develop team members, and build strong internal and external partnerships.
* Customer-focused solution design, initiative, adaptability, and quality orientation: respond to changing needs, solve problems proactively, and improve processes and creative work.

REQUIREMENTS
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (8 years). In addition to education or equivalent experience, requires at least 8 years of progressively responsible creative experience. Experience in an advertising agency or a high-performing in-house creative team is required. Prior people-management experience is preferred. A portfolio demonstrating strong creative thinking, concept development, and campaign effectiveness is required. Experience with digital-first marketing, direct response, testing and optimization, and responsible use of AI-enabled creative tools is strongly preferred.
  
  
SALARY & BENEFITS
  
**WVUS Pay Grade Level:** 228
  
**Estimated hiring range:** 104,200 - 151,590
  
  
The posted hiring salary range reflects pay for U.S. locations and is determined using market data and internal compensation guidelines. Actual compensation may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, and applicable laws. For information about World Vision U.S' comprehensive benefits package, please visit this link.
  
  
ABOUT WORLD VISION
  
We're a global Christian humanitarian organization. We partner with children, families, and their communities to empower them as they reach their full potential by tackling the causes of poverty and injustice. For 75 years, World Vision has followed Jesus' example to show unconditional love to the poor and oppressed. We serve every child regardless of faith.
  
  
**L.I.F.E. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:**  
The LIFE Leadership Competencies provide a shared framework for Christ-centered leadership at World Vision. They define the skills, behaviors, and character qualities that help leaders lead faithfully and effectively, shaping how we hire, develop, and evaluate leaders to cultivate thriving teams and greater Kingdom impact.
  
  

* Love: How we show up every day, every interaction. Loving others the way Jesus loves—with humility, care, and grace-filled truth. We build trust. We model life with God. And we create environments where people feel seen, valued, and supported, because we see the image of our God in each of them.
* Ignite: How we unlock and catalyze. To Ignite is to unlock purpose, passion, and potential—so people can bring their best in service of children and donors. We build healthy, thriving teams and develop character, competence, and courage.
* Fulfill: How We Deliver. To Fulfill is to focus on what matters most—and deliver with excellence and accountability. We own outcomes. We prioritize mission-critical work. And we partner with God to produce results that advance Kingdom impact.
* Envision: How we change and evolve towards ‘Better’. To Envision is to lead boldly into the future—discerning what’s ahead with faith, navigating complexity, and casting vision that leads to lasting impact.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
  
Due to the high volume of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for an initial phone conversation with a recruiter. Please include a link to a creative portfolio or website. We also encourage you to submit a PDF resume and a cover letter. Our goal is to fill this vacancy with the right person in the shortest amount of time.

title: Creative Director
description:
**The Company**

Said Differently is an untraditional agency bringing together strategy, creativity, design and technology to build brands, campaigns, products and platforms. We create bespoke teams around each client’s needs, combining a core team with specialists across our global network. Our mission is to build the marketing agency of the future, creating exceptional work through a more flexible, collaborative way of working.

**The role**  
You know how to find the thought that unlocks a brief and bring it to life. Sometimes it starts with a line. Sometimes it’s an image. Sometimes it’s an observation that becomes something neither discipline could have reached alone.

**We’re hiring two hands-on Creative Directors**: one with a deep copywriting background and another who moves comfortably between art and copy. Both will develop brand platforms and integrated campaigns, lead client assignments, and collaborate with freelance specialists across our network while continuing to make work themselves.

**For the copy-focused role,** you can build a brand platform, develop a campaign and write the headline everyone wishes they’d written. You have exceptional writing and editing skills, strong visual judgment, and understand how words and images work together.

**For the art-and-copy role**, you can write a compelling headline, establish a visual direction and bring both together into an idea with a clear point of view. Your particular strengths may lean toward one discipline, but your portfolio should show meaningful contributions to both.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Turn business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive creative platforms and integrated campaigns.
* Lead the creative work on assignments from the first conversation through production and delivery, protecting the idea as it evolves.
* Write headlines, scripts, concept narratives and other copy across film, social, digital, out of home, brand voice and other relevant channels.
* For the art-and-copy role, create visual directions, layouts and storyboards that communicate the idea.
* Partner with freelance writers, art directors, designers and other specialists, providing clear direction and useful feedback.
* Recognize when an idea needs stronger writing, better art direction or a different approach entirely.
* Build persuasive presentations and lead creative conversations with clients, explaining the thinking and building confidence in ambitious ideas.
* Help select and brief the right specialists for each assignment.
* Partner with strategy, account leadership and production to deliver strong work within the scope, budget and timeline.
* Contribute to pitches and identify creative opportunities within existing client relationships.

  

**What you’ll bring**

  

* 10+ years in advertising or brand creativity, with experience leading creative work at ACD or Creative Director level.
* A portfolio of original, strategically grounded ideas brought to life across multiple channels.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with range across brands, audiences and tones. The copy-focused role requires exceptional depth in this craft.
* Strong visual judgment and the ability to direct the complete campaign. The art-and-copy role also requires hands-on visual craft and proficiency with relevant design and presentation tools.
* Production experience relevant to your practice, including film, photography or digital content.
* Confidence working directly with clients and navigating feedback without losing the central idea.
* A generous approach to collaboration and the confidence to make clear creative decisions.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging creative tools, with sound judgment about where they improve the work.
* The independence and communication skills to lead within a distributed team.

  

**Show us**  
A portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative leadership. Tell us what you made, what you led and how you helped make the work happen.

**Working Hours**

We are a remote company and welcome candidates based in the US and internationally. Our team generally works Eastern Time hours, and this role requires availability during the standard Eastern Time workday to collaborate with colleagues and meet client needs.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

title: Art Director — Editorial Photography & Motion
description:

Sportiefs Matcha is a premium matcha collection under Maison Sportiefs, a lifestyle and wellness brand bringing together sport, culture, and everyday rituals.

We believe in creating experiences that extend beyond the product itself. Our creative approach emphasizes thoughtful design, refined aesthetics, and compelling visual storytelling.

As we continue developing our visual identity, we’re looking for an Art Director who can bring original concepts to life through photography, motion, and experimental visual production.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented Art Director with expertise in editorial product photography, stop-motion animation, and mixed-media content production.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who can take an idea from initial concept through production and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines a strong artistic perspective with technical production skills and an understanding of premium consumer brands.

You’ll help shape the visual direction of Sportiefs Matcha across digital campaigns, product launches, e-commerce, and social media.

We are particularly interested in creatives who enjoy experimenting with composition, lighting, movement, textures, and unconventional storytelling techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Direction & Concept Development

* Develop original creative concepts for product campaigns, seasonal launches, and digital storytelling.
* Translate brand references, mood boards, and creative briefs into distinctive visual concepts.
* Establish cohesive visual direction across photography, video, and motion projects.
* Explore innovative approaches to product presentation, animation, and visual storytelling.

Editorial Photography & Studio Production

* Conceptualize, style, and execute editorial product photography.
* Produce high-quality still-life imagery for website, e-commerce, advertising, and social platforms.
* Direct studio lighting, composition, backgrounds, props, and set styling.
* Capture product details, textures, and packaging with precision.
* Create visually compelling imagery while maintaining accurate product representation.

Motion & Mixed-Media Production

* Develop and produce stop-motion sequences, mixed-media animations, and short-form brand films.
* Combine photography, video, animation, and experimental techniques to create engaging visual content.
* Direct product movement, transitions, and visual effects.
* Edit and refine content for digital campaigns, website features, and social media.
* Experiment with creative production techniques that elevate traditional product advertising.

Post-Production & Creative Execution

* Oversee photo retouching, color correction, video editing, and animation.
* Maintain consistency in visual quality across all deliverables.
* Prepare final assets in appropriate formats for websites, digital advertising, and social media.
* Manage production timelines, creative assets, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with additional photographers, stylists, editors, or other creatives when required.

Qualifications & Experience

* A strong portfolio demonstrating editorial product photography, art direction, and visual storytelling.
* Experience producing stop-motion, mixed-media animation, or experimental motion content.
* Strong understanding of studio lighting, composition, color, texture, and product styling.
* Proficiency with professional photography and video equipment.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects, or equivalent professional software.
* Ability to independently conceptualize, shoot, edit, and deliver creative projects.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple creative deliverables.
* Excellent attention to detail and a refined visual aesthetic.
* Experience creating campaigns for beverage, beauty, fashion, wellness, or lifestyle brands is highly desirable.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re interested in someone who:

* Has a distinctive creative perspective and a strong visual portfolio.
* Understands how to make everyday products feel visually compelling.
* Can balance artistic experimentation with commercial brand objectives.
* Enjoys working with lighting, textures, movement, and unexpected compositions.
* Takes ownership of projects from concept through execution.
* Brings fresh ideas rather than relying exclusively on existing creative trends.
* Understands the importance of maintaining a cohesive brand identity.

Creative Focus

Projects may include:

* Editorial product photography and studio campaigns
* Stop-motion product animations
* Mixed-media brand films
* E-commerce product imagery
* Product launch campaigns
* Short-form motion content
* Creative set design and product styling
* Website visuals and digital advertising assets

How to Apply

Please submit the following to info@sportiefs.com:

* Your portfolio or website showcasing relevant creative work.
* Examples of editorial product photography, stop-motion, or mixed-media projects.
* A brief introduction describing your creative background and areas of expertise.
* Your location, availability, and preferred working arrangement.

Email subject: Art Director Application — Your Name

We are especially interested in portfolios that demonstrate originality, technical execution, and a thoughtful approach to visual storytelling.

We look forward to discovering creatives who can help bring the Sportiefs Matcha visual world to life.

Pay: From $1,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Designer & Art Director
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**
-------------------

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. The leading provider of K-12 AI+CS education curriculum across the globe, CodeAI also organizes the annual Hour of AI campaign, building on the legacy of the Hour of Code, which has engaged more than 15% of all students in the world!

**A unifying approach in a divided world**
------------------------------------------

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. **Read more**.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you'll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you'll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You'll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

**Visual Direction & Design**

* Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
* Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
* Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
* Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
* Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

**Concepting & Art Direction**

* Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
* Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
* Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
* Direct contract designers and creatives when they're brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

**Brand Stewardship**

* Own the visual elements of the CodeAI brand guidelines and evolve them over time, with final approval resting with the Executive Producer.
* Be the go-to resource for visual brand questions, helping teams across CodeAI and external partners apply the guidelines well.
* Present your work to leadership and stakeholders with clear strategic reasoning, using audience insights and performance data to sharpen it.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

  

We seek candidates who have:

* 8 to 10 years in graphic design and art direction, including time at a senior level.
* A portfolio showing both hands-on design craft and integrated campaign work, with your specific role noted on each project.
* Expert typography, layout, and composition skills, with the ability to flex across visual styles.
* Experience concepting with copywriters, with produced campaign work to show for it.
* Experience art directing photo or video shoots through post.
* Experience building or evolving brand guidelines and helping other teams apply them.
* Experience directing the work of other creatives.
* Experience using AI tools in a creative workflow.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.

We prefer candidates who also have:

* Agency or design studio experience.
* Experience with education, nonprofit, or mission-driven brands.
* Motion design or video editing skills.

In addition, candidates must:

* Be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
* Work within the continental United States
* Pass a pre-employment background check
* Be willing to travel a minimum of two times per year for team events

**OUR CULTURAL PRINCIPLES**
---------------------------

The way we work matters as much as the work itself. Before you apply, we invite you to take a look at our cultural principles. They reflect who we are, how we show up for each other, and what we look for in the people who join us.
