title: Creative Director
description:
Where passion meets opportunity
  
  
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
  
  
Your Purpose
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic, visionary Creative Director to lead and evolve the creative strategy and execution for MSC Cruises during an exciting period of transformation and growth. This role oversees integrated B2B and B2C creative spanning brand, digital, trade, partnerships, CRM, social, and experiential touchpoints, ensuring compelling, customer-centric storytelling and consistent brand expression in the U.S. and Canada.
  
  
The Creative Director leads and inspires a multidisciplinary team while working closely with cross-functional and global partners to deliver high-impact campaigns that drive growth and elevate the brand. This role plays a critical part in shaping how MSC Cruises connects with guests and trade audiences through innovative, insight-driven creative.
  
  
Based in Miami with a hybrid schedule (Monday–Thursday in office, Friday remote), you’ll elevate our brand across all guest and trade touchpoints, while driving more AI-enabled workflows, scalable content operations, and Adobe-based marketing and creative capabilities.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Define and lead the creative vision across all guest and trade touchpoints, ensuring a distinctive, consistent, and compelling brand experience.
* Lead the development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns spanning brand, digital, CRM, social, trade marketing, partnerships, promotions, and experiential channels.
* Evolve brand identity, voice, and visual systems across campaigns, digital channels, trade materials, signage, and experiential activations.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Trade Marketing, Product, Operations, and Global Marketing teams to align creative strategy with business priorities and localize campaigns for U.S. and Canadian audiences.
* Lead, mentor, recruit, and inspire a multidisciplinary creative team while fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee creative operations including workflows, production processes, budgets, timelines, asset management systems, and agency/vendor relationships to improve efficiency and speed-to-market.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI tools, workflow automation, and emerging technologies to enhance creative operations, content production, personalization, and team efficiency.
* Support the adoption of Adobe marketing and creative platforms while championing innovation in storytelling, multimedia production, and experiential design.
* Ensure high-quality, on-brand creative output across all touchpoints and present campaign concepts and creative rationale to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Monitor consumer, creative, technology, and digital marketing trends to ensure the MSC Cruises brand remains culturally relevant and competitively positioned.

Your Journey so far
  
  

* 8+ years of senior creative leadership experience, including 3+ years in a Creative Director or equivalent leadership role within an agency or consumer-facing organization.
* Experience within hospitality, travel, entertainment, luxury, lifestyle, or similarly brand-driven industries strongly preferred.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating integrated campaigns across brand, digital, CRM, social, trade marketing, partnerships, and experiential channels.
* Expert visual, conceptual, storytelling, and strategic thinking capabilities with strong hands-on creative leadership skills.
* Proven experience recruiting, mentoring, developing, and scaling multidisciplinary creative teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders within matrixed and global organizations.
* Experience managing agencies, freelance partners, vendors, and large-scale creative budgets and production processes.
* Experience leveraging AI tools, workflow automation, and emerging creative technologies preferred.
* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud required; familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and/or related marketing technology platforms strongly preferred.
* Strong executive communication, presentation, project management, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of production processes across print, digital, video, multimedia, and environmental signage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Advertising, Fine Arts, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Must be based in or willing to relocate to Miami, FL

Your Essentials
  
  

* US Passport or US Permanent Resident
* MSC Cruises is an E-Verify employer

MSC Cruises USA is an equal opportunity employer that complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules and regulations. It is our policy to employ and promote qualified candidates without discrimination on the basis of race, color, sex, age, origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on merit, qualifications and business needs.
  
  
Our commitment
  
  
We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.
  
  
Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

title: Head of Creative (Remote US)
description:
**Directive Consulting** is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: **Performance, Communications, and Commerce,** each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, **DiscoverabilityOS**, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and **Content** Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Head of Creative to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

**Creative Leadership & Output**

* Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
* Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
* Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
* Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
* Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
* Ensure we are testing & learning
* Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

**People Management & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
* Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
* Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
* Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
* Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

**Financial Ownership**

* Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
* Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

**AI & Technology Integration**

* Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
* Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
* Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

**WHAT YOU OFFER**

**Experience & Background**

* 5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
* Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
* Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

**Business Acumen**

* Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
* Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
* You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

**AI & Tools**

* Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
* Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
* Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
* Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

**What Success Looks Like:**

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.

Within six months, you're running the department with full confidence — driving creative quality, owning margin targets, making smart resourcing decisions, and positioning Performance Design as a competitive differentiator in new business conversations.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* We have a set living wage at Directive; The annual base salary range for this position based in the US is $160,000-$185,000 USD. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience.
* Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

  + Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, fertility support through Carrott, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
  + Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
  + Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
  + Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

You will need a reliable setup, high-speed internet, and a professional working environment capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and video production software without interruption.

We accommodate global candidates in markets where Directive has established business operations, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in healthtech, marketplace, or two-sided platforms
* Experience working with AI-assisted support tools or automation workflows
* Familiarity with Intercom, Zendesk, or equivalent support tooling
* SQL knowledge or comfort querying data independently
* Experience onboarding a new org structure or consolidating teams
* Strong plus — Spanish, Italian, Polish, or German language speaker.

**What to Expect from Our Hiring Process**

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

**Intro Chat** – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

**Hiring Manager Interview** – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with your Hiring Manager and your potential manager in this role**.** Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

**Business Case –** A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

**Additional/ Final Interview (Optional)** – A final conversation with another senior stakeholder from our Global Team.

**References & Offer!**

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Global Benefits –** No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

* Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
* Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
* Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

**Local Perks –** Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

**Career Growth –** We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

**A Truly Global Team –** Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility That Works for You –** Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

*Please note:*At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

**What We Believe In**

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

**Focus on results –** we're here to make an impact.

**Think like an owner –** take responsibility, drive outcomes.

**Keep it simple, keep it lean –** smart solutions over complexity.

**Be respectful and radically honest –** openness builds trust.

**Learn and be curious –** growth is part of the job.

title: SDR Team Lead - Benelux & Nordics
description:
**About Us**  
  
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  
  
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.  
  
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  
  
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  
  
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a motivated aspiring manager to take their step into leadership as an SDR Team Lead, supporting our Benelux & Nordics markets within our Barcelona-based Sales team. You’ll coach and support a team of outbound SDRs, helping them develop their skills, generate pipeline, and hit their targets. You’ll partner closely with the SDR Manager and Head of Sales Development to shape strategies, improve processes, and ensure the team’s success directly contributes to Perk’s growth.

**What will you be doing?**

* Lead and support a team of Outbound SDRs, running weekly 1:1s, setting development goals, and reviewing performance.
* Coach & mentor, focus on continuous skill development, identify training needs, and support new hires during onboarding.
* Enable growth, design and deliver engaging training (role-plays, pitch simulations, gamification) and share best practices across the team.
* Be the expert, master Perk’s products and confidently guide your team in delivering value to prospects.
* Collaborate, partner with SDR Managers and internal stakeholders to create playbooks, scripts, and materials that drive results.
* Drive operational excellence by improving processes, ensuring data accuracy, and fostering efficiency across the SDR function.
* Lead AI-first prospecting: make AI a core part of how your team works, from account and persona research to personalised messaging, sequence building, and call prep. Coach your SDRs to use AI to cut manual work and spend more time on quality conversations, test new workflows, measure their impact on pipeline, and scale what works across the team
* Foster cross-functional communication with Sales, aligning on goals, feedback, and strategies to maximise impact.

**What will you need to succeed?**

* You have extensive experience in outbound sales/sales development and have successfully managed the full sales cycle from prospecting and lead generation through to opportunity creation and closing.

* You are passionate about coaching and developing junior talent. You experiment, adapt, and grow, and you inspire your team to do the same through hands-on guidance and training. For this role we don’t require direct leadership experience, but previous coaching and mentoring of junior team members is a must have.
* Own team performance: track activity, pipeline, and SQL targets weekly, spot risks early, and turn data into clear coaching actions.
* You’re a clear communicator. You can break down complex ideas into simple, actionable steps and write concise messages that get straight to the point.
* You’re a great listener. You take the time to understand your team, picking up on the nuance that helps drive better conversations and coaching.
* You’re organised and focused. You know where to prioritise your energy to maximise results, for yourself and your team, and you don’t shy away from putting in the extra effort.
* You’re detail-oriented. You take pride in operational excellence, from accurate CRM updates to preparing your team for success.
* You embrace tools and technology. You leverage systems to drive productivity and are always curious about smarter, more efficient ways of working.

**What it’s like to work at Perk:**

* We build a product that makes a real difference, because selling something great is the best way to win customers.
* We put people first in every interaction, leading with empathy and expertise.
* Small, talented teams can achieve big things. That’s why we hire the best, give them the right environment, and reward them fairly.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays.
* Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.
* Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance.
* Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.
* Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.
* Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.
* Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan.
* Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year.
* Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.
* Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.
* Nurture your language skills with real-life English, Spanish and Catalan lessons.
* Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years
* Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

**Interview process:**
----------------------

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

Interview with the hiring manager - 30mins Virtual

Assessment interview with the hiring manager - 60mins - Virtual

Senior Leadership interview - 30mins In-Person

Values fit interview - 30mins Virtual

**AI at Perk**  
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

We combine deep AdTech expertise, proprietary technology, and a data-driven mindset to deliver transparency, performance, and efficiency in the mobile advertising ecosystem.  
  
**Why BidMachine?**  
At BidMachine, we are building more than an exchange — we are shaping the infrastructure that powers fair, efficient, and scalable in-app programmatic advertising.  
Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control.  
We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech.

**Here's what we value, and what we hope you do too:**

**Ownership & Accountability**  
We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success.

**Data-Informed Excellence**  
We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results.

**Innovation & Technical Depth**  
We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem.

**Global Collaboration**  
We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards.

**Ambition & Impact**  
We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market.

BidMachine is looking for a hands-on Head of Non-Gaming Partnerships (Mediation) to bring non-gaming app publishers onto our mediation platform and grow them.

This role combines go-to-market and product for one segment: non-gaming apps such as utility, weather, fitness, health, news, AI and consumer-brand apps. You'll choose which segments and markets to win first, sign the publishers, get them integrated and live alongside the platforms they already run, and bring our account-management team in from the first day of each integration. The first direct non-gaming publishers are already live, so you start from real accounts and a revenue target, not a blank page.

Success here isn't measured by activity or meetings. It's measured by the revenue the non-gaming publishers you bring live generate, how lean your squad stays, and how repeatable the path to the next publisher becomes.

You'll build and lead a small squad across commercial, product and engineering work, and work closely with the other mediation squads, our exchange and our sales team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who has built or run a mediation, or who has connected ad demand directly to non-gaming publishers, and knows that the largest platforms win publishers on brand. Non-gaming publishers won't come to us that way: they have to be won outbound, from a platform they already use. We're looking for someone who understands the SDK and the integration well enough to make a demanding publisher say yes, and who turns what publishers ask for into product changes that ship.

**Location:** Barcelona, Spain. Relocation supported.

**In your first 90 days:** a product and go-to-market plan built from your own market and competitor analysis, one integration completed with a publisher who has already signed, and a list of target publishers for our sales team.

### **Responsibilities:**

**Choose where to play**

* Pick the non-gaming segments and markets to go after first, and say why.
* Write the plan, with a revenue goal and the leading indicators you'll track every week.

**Sign non-gaming publishers**

* Lead the commercial effort for the segment, outbound, together with our sales and business development teams.
* Win publishers from the platform they use today: understand their stack, their objections and what it takes for them to switch or add us.

**Get them integrated and live**

* Own the path from signature to live traffic, working with engineering, alongside the other mediation and ad platforms the publisher already runs.
* Go after quality inventory: native and video formats and strong audiences, with banners where they still earn.

**Shape the product**

* Translate what non-gaming publishers need (formats, demand, integration effort) into clear requirements for the SDK and the platform, and follow them through until they ship.
* Make the case for non-gaming needs on a roadmap and a shared SDK you don't own, with numbers from real publishers.

**Ramp and hand over**

* Work with the account-management team from the first day of each integration, take each account to live and earning, and hand it over with the terms written down and nothing lost.

**Build and lead the squad**

* Choose the people the work needs, set priorities and keep the squad as small as the job allows.

**Watch the market and write it down**

* Track how competing mediation platforms work with non-gaming publishers, market by market.
* Keep plans, decisions and the state of each integration written down where the team can see them.

### **Requirements:**

* **Mediation, or direct non-gaming monetization.** You have built or run a mobile ad mediation in a product, go-to-market, partnerships, publisher business development or solutions role. Or you have connected ad demand directly to non-gaming app publishers: inside a publisher's own mediation or custom ad stack, or through Google Ad Manager.
* **Product and commercial in one person.** You have signed publishers or partners, and you have shaped a product. You are technical enough to discuss SDKs, integrations, bidding and waterfalls with engineers.
* **Non-gaming app publishers.** You have worked with app publishers outside games and can describe what you did to bring them on and grow them.
* **More than one region.** You have worked with publishers in more than one market.
* **Team leadership.** You have led a small cross-functional team with revenue or P&L targets: chosen people, set priorities and coached them.
* **Demonstrated AI experience, required.** Practical hands-on use of AI tools in publisher, partnerships or product work, with the ability to describe the specific workflows you improved, the results delivered, and how you validated the output.

### **Nice to have:**

* You built a mediation product and the go-to-market plan for it.
* Experience on a mediation platform that grew significantly while you were there.
* Native and video formats, and publisher audience or data monetization.
* Spanish.

With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space.

**Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!**

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
### **About Hilo by Aktiia**

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

### **Role overview**

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

### **Core responsibilities**

### **Direction & Outcomes**

* Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
* Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

### **Design System & Prototyping**

* Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
* Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
* Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
* Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

 **Requirements**

### **Background & Experience**

### **Essential**

* Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
* 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
* Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
* High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
* Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
* Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
* Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
* Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
* A public portfolio website (required with your application).

### **Nice to Have**

* Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

### **How you work**

* AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
* Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
* Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
* Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
* Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
* Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

### **This isn't for you if**

* You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
* You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
* You'd rather list risks than own one.

### **How we hire**

* Recruiter screen (30 min)
* Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
* Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
* Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
* Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

### **What success looks like**

* You take something off our plate and it gets done.
* If it won't happen, you tell us first.
* You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
* You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
* The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

  
**Benefits**

### **What Makes You A Great Fit**

**At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:**

**Move the Needle** — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

**Move Fast, Learn, Refine** — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

**Team First** — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
* Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
* Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
* Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
* Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

### **Ready to Move the Needle?**

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Director of Brand & Creative
description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

*Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our* *contentsquare.com* *or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.*

We are looking for a senior creative leader to **define the next chapter of Contentsquare’s brand and lead the evolution of our global Studio.**

You will set the creative vision for how Contentsquare shows up in the world. Your mission is to elevate our brand, making it more distinctive, modern, and recognizable, and ensuring our creative expression positions us as a leader in our industry.

You will drive the **creative evolution of our brand across every touchpoint**, from campaigns and product launches to web, events, motion, and executive storytelling. You'll push creative boundaries, champion bold ideas, and set an exceptional standard for quality and differentiation.

A key part of the role is translating complex technology, data, and AI innovation into simple, compelling creative experiences. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, and GTM teams to understand what makes our platform unique and bring that story to life.

You'll also **lead and transform our global Studio**, developing a high-performing team of designers, creative leads, and agency partners. You'll evolve our brand system and embrace AI, automation, and self-service to scale production, freeing the team to focus on creativity, craft, and high-impact work.

**Your mission: build a category-defining brand and a world-class, AI-enabled creative organization to bring it to life.**

### **What you’ll own**

### **Brand creative direction**

* Set the creative vision for Contentsquare and hold an exceptional standard across launches, campaigns, brand, web, events, and executive storytelling.
* Champion bold ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and push the team beyond safe, predictable creative work.
* Stay ahead of what the best brands are doing, in SaaS, AI, technology, and beyond, to create work that is unmistakably ours.

### **The team**

* Lead, develop, and retain exceptional designers and team leads, building a high-performing culture of craft, bold thinking, ownership, and accountability. Empower the team to take creative risks and make strong decisions independently.
* Build and manage a network of world-class agencies and specialist partners, bringing fresh perspectives and expertise. Own agency selection, creative direction, budgets, and performance, ensuring exceptional quality and the flexibility to scale during peak demand.

### **The platform and product story**

* Build a deep understanding of our platform, AI capabilities, and technology, keeping the Studio closely connected to our product and customers.
* Partner early with Product and Product Marketing to turn complex technology into simple, compelling, and memorable creative experiences.
* Bring our product story to life through distinctive design, motion, video, and storytelling across every relevant touchpoint.

### **The Brand System**

* Evolve our visual identity into a distinctive, recognizable, and scalable brand system that reflects our ambition as an AI leader.
* Build reusable frameworks, templates, and self-service tools that help teams create effectively without compromising quality.
* Know when to scale through the system and when an idea deserves something entirely new.

### **AI in the studio**

* Lead how the Studio uses AI across design, copy, production, and creative operations.
* Use AI to absorb repetitive work and production volume, expanding creative capabilities and giving the team more time for ideas, craft, and innovation.
* Help the team adopt new tools and workflows confidently, without compromising creative quality or brand standards.

### **How the creative studio runs**

* Own the Studio operating model, including priorities, resourcing, project management, creative reviews, and delivery across internal teams and external partners.
* Build a fast, effective, and scalable operation that anticipates demand, manages production peaks, and removes unnecessary complexity.
* Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Brand, Content, Web, Comms, and GTM teams, engaging early enough to shape the work rather than simply receive briefs.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years across design, brand, creative, or Studio leadership, including 5+ years leading teams in SaaS or technology.
* Experience managing managers/team leads and operating in complex, global organizations.
* Exceptional portfolio with a high creative bar across brand, digital, campaigns, and product storytelling.
* Strong ability to turn complex technology and AI into simple, compelling creative narratives.
* Deep understanding of SaaS/tech; AI or AI-native experience is a strong plus.
* Proven experience evolving brand/design systems and scaling quality through templates and self-service.
* Hands-on experience transforming creative teams with AI across workflows, automation, production, and enablement.
* Strong command of Creative Operations, resourcing, agencies, and end-to-end Studio workflows.
* Strong benchmarking instincts and a clear point of view on differentiation and creative excellence.
* Excellent executive communication and cross-functional partnership skills.

### **You’ll Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have **exceptional creative taste and a strong point of view** on what our brand could become.
* Understand the product deeply enough to find the creative idea within it, rather than waiting for a brief to define it.
* Turn complex technology, data, and AI into simple, human, and memorable creative experiences.
* Know what the best brands are doing, both in our category and far beyond it, and are more interested in **what nobody has done yet**.
* Move confidently between setting creative vision, challenging the details, shaping product storytelling, and leading a high-performing team.
* See **AI as a way to take more creative risks, not fewer**. Let it handle the volume so your team can focus on the work only people can do.
* Build simple systems that keep creative teams fast, collaborative, and effective, while knowing which work deserves something entirely original.
* Challenge work that's merely good enough, inspiring teams and agency partners to push for exceptional.
* Balance bold creative ambition with a strong understanding of customer impact and business outcomes.

### **What Success Looks Like**

Within your first year, we would expect to see:

* A visibly higher and more consistent creative bar across the company.
* A distinctive creative language for our platform, products, and AI capabilities that makes complex technology easier to understand and more exciting to experience.
* A Studio that is deeply connected to Product and Product Marketing and engaged earlier in the storytelling process.
* Strong differentiation from competitors across our visual identity, campaigns, product launches, and customer-facing experiences.
* A strong, scalable brand and design system.
* A clear Studio operating model with stronger prioritization, ownership, and delivery.
* Meaningful adoption of AI across creative workflows, resulting in faster execution, better output, and expanded team capacity.
* More teams able to self-serve effectively through high-quality templates, systems, and guidelines.
* Strong leadership across the Studio, with team leads operating with greater autonomy and accountability.
* Better balance between internal resources, agencies, automation, and self-service.
* A Studio viewed by the business not as a production function, but as a strategic partner in how we bring our product and technology to the world.

**Why you should join Contentsquare**

We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.

Here are a few we want to highlight:

* Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year

* Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies

* Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)

* Lifestyle allowance

* A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work

* Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success

* We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts

* And more benefits tailored to each country

*Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our* *Job Candidate Privacy Notice* *to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal* *here**.*

*Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.*

*Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our* *Candidate Privacy Policy**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Are you an experienced marketing project manager who wants to join multicultural team? We are looking for a **Marketing Project Lead** who can grow alongside the project and reach new heights. You’ll be part of a creative and friendly team in a people-oriented environment that values autonomy, results-driven thinking, and achieving business goals.  
  
**Brandbutter** is part of **CENTRO** is a fully remote creative marketing agency partnering with ambitious brands to build awareness, relevance, and growth in fast-moving markets. We work across strategy, content, campaigns, and events, operating as an embedded partner rather than a task-based service provider.

**About the role**  
You’ll lead one of our two marketing cells, covering several brands across B2B fintech, adtech and creator programs. You’ll own the marketing vision and roadmap for these brands and lead a team of designers and social media managers to deliver it.

This is a player-coach role, not a pure management one. You’ll set direction and lead the team, but you’ll also spend a large share of your time doing the work yourself: writing the strategy, building campaigns, drafting copy, setting up ads and building AI workflows. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing.

* **Set the vision.** Define the marketing strategy for each brand in your cell, grounded in business goals, customer insight and data.
* **Build and run the roadmap.** Turn quarterly OKRs into clear plans with priorities, owners and timelines, and make sure they ship.
* **Execute hands-on.** Write briefs, copy and campaign plans. Launch and optimise paid campaigns. Build landing pages and reports. Produce first versions yourself instead of waiting on others.
* **Lead and grow the team.** Coach designers and social media managers, delegate with clarity, give direct feedback and help people grow.
* **Make AI the default.** Identify where AI and automation can speed up research, content production, reporting and campaign operations, build those workflows yourself and teach the team to use them.
* **Own the numbers.** Track pipeline, lead quality, CPL, ROAS and engagement, and change course when something isn’t working.
* **Work across the business.** Partner with sales, product, tech and leadership, and present plans and results clearly and concisely.

  
**What you bring:**

* 7+ years in marketing, including at least 3 years leading a team. You can name people who grew under you.
* A doer’s track record: you’ve personally written, built, launched and optimised campaigns, not only managed people who did.
* Experience building marketing strategies and roadmaps from scratch, ideally across more than one brand or audience.

* **Competitive salary** that reflects your skills and experience.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

If the answer is yes, we have an exciting opportunity for you to help architect the next chapter of **Uvance Wayfinders** , Fujitsu’s global consulting brand, in Iberia.

  

Uvance Wayfinders is committed to guiding customers through business and management transformation, turning concepts into reality and delivering tangible results through our consulting approach. Working side by side with clients, we deliver integrated solutions that span the full lifecycle of change, from initial strategy to sustained impact. We are focussed on fostering an inclusive environment where diverse talent thrives.

  

In Iberia (Spain and Portugal), we are building the practice from the ground up, with Data & AI at its core and an initial focus on Banking & Insurance, Energy & Utilities and the Public Sector. We connect strategy, technology and execution end-to-end, from the first diagnosis through to production.

  

**Your role will involve:**

As Associate Partner for Banking & Insurance, you’ll work closely with the Consulting Partner to build and grow the sector across Iberia, with the end customer at the centre. Your challenge is to help banks and insurers grow through their customers, not just through price, using AI to know them better, serve them better and design new value propositions.

  

As a market-facing visionary, you’ll be targeted to pursue new revenue and business development opportunities, whilst nurturing key client relationships, and leading collaborative, high-performing consulting teams. Your exceptional ability to build and maintain lasting, trusted relationships will empower clients to fulfil their business aspirations.

  

As a thought leader in your field, you’ll influence the future of Uvance Wayfinders consulting, bringing fresh perspectives and creative, innovative solutions.

  

**As an Associate Partner, you will be responsible for:**

**Business Development**

* Driving the go-to-market strategy for Banking & Insurance in Iberia and leading business development efforts, including proactive proposals, RFPs and executive presentations, resulting in standalone consulting revenue growth.
* Defining our proposition for banks and insurers around the customer: growth, customer experience, new products and services, and efficiency in how customers are served.
* Identifying and sizing growth opportunities for clients, both organic (new businesses, propositions or channels) and through partnerships and ecosystems.
* Identifying pull-through opportunities for technology solutions and services through consulting engagements and gained knowledge of clients’ business challenges.
* Shaping complex value cases and facilitating executive workshops that link AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.
* Leading deal shaping, pricing and commercial negotiations, and managing revenue, margin and delivery health across engagements.
* Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities with banks and insurers across Iberia.
* Creating eminence and thought leadership through provocative points of view on AI, customer experience and growth in financial services.
  

**Client delivery & leadership**

* Setting the direction for complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements, identifying the right functional knowledge, technical expertise and proprietary tools required to deliver.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the C-suite of banks and insurers on customer strategy, customer experience and AI-driven transformation.
* Designing customer experience strategies powered by AI and data: personalisation, agent-based customer service, frictionless processes and retention.
* Advising clients on how to deploy AI in customer-facing processes in line with sector regulation, including DORA, the EU AI Act and supervisory expectations.
* Turning strategy into pilots with clear business metrics (acquisition, conversion, retention, cost to serve) and scaling them into production.
* Collaborating with the wider Uvance Wayfinders network and technology partners to bring the right capabilities and solutions to each client challenge.
* Providing senior technical oversight across multiple AI and data engagements.
* Validating architectural approaches spanning data platforms, machine learning, large language models, AI agents and orchestration layers.
* Ensuring AI solutions are production-grade, scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards, with strong engineering discipline and MLOps practices.
* Guiding teams on trade-offs between rules-based systems, machine learning, LLMs and hybrid approaches.
* Acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, architectural or Responsible AI decisions.
* Building and sustaining long-term client relationships, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
  

**Practice development**

* Collaborating with the Consulting Partner to shape the Banking & Insurance offering, including methodologies, accelerators and thought leadership.
* Building a high-performing Banking & Insurance team, providing direction, mentorship and quality assurance over team performance and deliverables.
* Working with Uvance Wayfinders partners across Europe and with the teams already present in client accounts.
* Inspiring Uvance Wayfinders consultants to realise their full potential, supporting collaboration, continuous development and a culture where talent thrives.
  

**Your transferable skills and experience:**

* 14+ years of experience in consulting or equivalent senior industry leadership roles, including experience at Associate Partner, Director or Managing Director level in a tier-one consultancy or technology advisory firm.
* Proven ability to build trusted C-suite relationships and originate consulting revenue.
* Experience working with banking and insurance clients in Iberia.
* Strong track record in customer strategy, customer experience and growth, using data and technology as levers.
* A clear view of where AI changes the economics of the business: the cost of knowing customers, serving them and building new propositions.
* Solid knowledge of the regulatory framework for banking and insurance (including DORA and the EU AI Act) and its impact on AI and customer initiatives.
* Successful delivery leadership across complex, technology-enabled transformation programmes.
* Experience building practices or offerings from scratch and taking them to market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach to growing, developing and inspiring cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of modern data and AI architectures, including cloud-native data platforms and pipelines, machine learning and advanced analytics, LLM-based solutions (prompting, RAG, agents), and orchestration, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Experience overseeing AI systems in production and understanding their operational risks: performance, drift, reliability and security.

The Data Platform Engineer builds and runs the platform that all of Graitec's reporting, analytics and AI depend on: the Microsoft Fabric data lake, the pipelines that feed it, and the controls that keep it reliable, secure and affordable.

The priority is a governed single source of truth: data from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, services

licensing and product telemetry, integrated once, modelled consistently and served to every function, with sensitive data protected by design.

You will work with the Data and AI Leader, BI developers, IT Operations & Platforms, Information Security and R&D. It is a hands-on senior engineering role, setting the patterns others build on.

Key Outcomes Expected

What success looks like in the first 12 months

* A published data platform architecture and engineering standards, with a layered data model in use
* Core sources ingested reliably and monitored, with failures detected before users notice
* Platform capacity right-sized and its cost transparent, with workloads separated so reporting and engineering do not collide
* Access, classification and privacy controls in place, including for HR and financial data
* Pipelines and models in source control, with automated deployment across environments
* A clear interface with R&D for product telemetry and shared data platforms

Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

* Design, build and run the Microsoft Fabric platform: lakehouses, warehouses, pipelines and dataflows
* Ingest and integrate data from Dynamics 365, CRM, Kantata, licensing and telemetry, using standard connectors and APIs where they fit
* Build a layered, medallion-style data model that turns raw data into certified, reusable datasets
* Resolve customer and product identities across CRM, ERP, licensing and telemetry, so every report counts the same customer once

Reliability & Cost

* Monitor pipelines and automate data quality tests for completeness, freshness, uniqueness and referential integrity, with alerting and clear ownership of failures
* Manage platform capacity and cost, separating workloads and scaling only when justified
* Run source control, environments and deployment pipelines for data and BI content

Security & Governance

* Implement access, classification, row- and column-level security, masking and privacy controls with Information Security
* Protect sensitive data such as compensation, using anonymisation and restricted workspaces
* Maintain lineage and documentation, supporting the data governance the business agrees

Collaboration

* Set engineering standards and coach BI developers and analysts in using them
* Work with the Enterprise Architect and R&D on integration patterns, master data and telemetry
* Prepare data for AI, exposing governed, well-described data to agents and models through controlled interfaces

Responsibilities:

* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, including at least two years working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Databricks.
* Strong experience with SQL and Python or PySpark, and data modelling for analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, and OneLake.
* Experience integrating ERP and CRM data, ideally from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Dataverse.
* Experience with master data management and entity resolution, including matching customers and products across multiple systems.
* Practical experience implementing security and governance, including Entra ID, row-level security, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience managing capacity and costs on a shared analytics platform.
* Uses AI tools such as Copilot in day-to-day work for code generation, testing, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to document effectively and explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders.
* Experience with product telemetry or event-driven data.
* Experience preparing data for AI solutions, including retrieval, vector search, and governed access for agents (for example through MCP).
* Experience with other modern data platforms and tools such as dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks, and with infrastructure as code.

Qualifications:

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Python/PySpark** development.
* Expertise in **analytics-focused data modelling** and data architecture.
* Deep knowledge of **Microsoft Fabric** technologies, including:
  + Lakehouse
  + Warehouse
  + Data Pipelines
  + Notebooks
  + OneLake
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD practices for data platforms**, including Git and Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of enterprise **security, governance, and compliance frameworks**, including:
  + Entra ID
  + Row-Level Security (RLS)
  + Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of data platform operations, including performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Practical application of AI-assisted development tools such as **Copilot**.
* **Preferred Certifications**
  + Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (**DP-700**)
  + Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (**DP-600**)
* Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Vector Search
  + MCP-enabled data access and governance
