title: Team Lead, Reliability Engineering
Supply Chain Transformation Lead – Head of Anaplan Supply Chain South
description:
### **About the role**

As **Head of Anaplan Supply Chain South**, you have **three roles.** **You grow our Anaplan business** in Switzerland, Austria, Iberia and France, together with Anaplan. **You lead complex end-to-end supply chain transformation programs** for our clients. And you **lead and develop your squad** of (senior) consultants. You also drive the AI transformation in your region: in what we bring to clients and in how we deliver.

**What you'll do**

**Drive growth in the South region**

* Own the growth of our Anaplan business in Switzerland, Austria, Iberia and France.
* Build a strong partnership with the regional Anaplan teams. Plan accounts together, run joint campaigns and win deals together.
* Identify and shape new opportunities with new and existing clients. Collaborate with our sales and presales team, who support you through the full sales cycle.
* Bring AI into client conversations. Help clients see where AI improves their planning decisions, and turn that into new opportunities.
* Use your understanding of the local markets to strengthen Bluecrux' presence and reputation in the region.
* Set regional priorities together with fellow Bluecrux leaders.

**Lead end-to-end supply chain transformation programs**

* Lead complex supply chain planning transformations, from scoping and design through implementation.
* Bring deep supply chain planning expertise. Challenge and guide clients on their planning processes.
* Lead the solution design together with the client. Make sure design decisions support the client's business objectives.
* Use AI to make our delivery faster and better. Apply AI tools in design, build and testing, and share what works with other squads.
* Deliver the end-to-end implementation with a team of solution architects and model builders. Set clear plans, governance and responsibilities. Manage risks and dependencies.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders. Guide them through difficult decisions and grow the collaboration over time.

**Build and lead your squad**

* Lead your squad as their team lead. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback and manage performance. Foster innovation, collaboration and high quality in everything we do.
* Support each team member's career development and support your team leads to do the same.
* Build the skills and leadership capacity your squad needs as the business grows.
* Drive AI adoption in your squad. Make sure your team builds AI skills and uses AI in their daily work.
* Hire new talent and grow the team in line with regional growth.
* Bring lessons from clients and projects back into our Anaplan offering, together with other Bluecrux leaders.

#LI-AH1

### **About you**

***Growth and partnership***

* You have a track record of growing client relationships and winning new work. You identify opportunities and shape proposals in collaboration with our sales and presales team.
* You bring an entrepreneurial mindset. You set direction, take initiative and follow through.
* You are comfortable working with technology partners to build a joint pipeline.
* You are driven by the change AI brings to supply chain planning and consulting. You experiment, learn fast and take others with you.

***Supply chain transformation***

* You bring substantial consulting experience in supply chain planning transformation.
* You understand end-to-end supply chain planning. You guide clients and teams from design through implementation.
* You have led transformations with Anaplan or comparable planning solutions, such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis or OMP. You do not need technical Anaplan expertise. Your strength is leading delivery, aligning stakeholders and managing teams.
* You oversee multiple engagements, support project leads and take accountability for delivery outcomes.
* You build credibility with senior client stakeholders. You guide conversations on business priorities, transformation decisions and investment.

***Team leadership***

* You have experience in leading and developing teams, including performance management, coaching and career development.

***General***

* You are fluent in English. Spanish or French is a plus.
* You have a master’s degree in Economics, Engineering or another related field.
* You are ready to represent our values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind.
* You work well in an international team with a hybrid working model. You travel to clients (20%) and Bluecrux offices (Barcelona ES, Mechelen/Aalst BE, Zug CH – Min 40%).
* You have a valid driving license, or you obtain one within six months.

### **Why join us?**

* **Shape regional growth.** You decide with us where and how we grow our Anaplan supply chain business in the South region.
* **Lead complex transformations.** You guide clients through programs that change how they plan, and you build lasting relationships.
* **Lead your own squad.** You own your team's performance, development and growth.
* **Shape innovation into a concrete offering.** You work with fellow leaders and partners to develop our planning capabilities, embed AI in everything we do and bring innovation to our clients.
* **Shape how we use AI.** You help define how AI changes our client offering and the way we deliver.

* Enjoy a flexible & hybrid work environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
* Benefit from a **competitive salary** package, complete with **multiple extra-legal perks** designed to reward your expertise.

### **About us**

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

#### **Anaplan**

With the power of **Anaplan**, a leading connected planning solution, and our planning expertise, we help our customers make the right planning decisions and drive growth. We connect people, plans and data, bring scenario planning capabilities and connect supply chain to sales, finance and HR. Visit our Anaplan page to learn more about our services and the implementations we have worked on with our customers.

Our Anaplan squad is a successful and fast-growing part of the consulting business unit. We make a difference for clients by combining our strong supply chain and Anaplan expertise. We are **the** supply chain frontrunner in the Anaplan eco-system, having been awarded multiple awards to recognise our impact. We love to collaborate with Anaplan sales, product and customer success teams to develop the best solutions for and with our clients. We bring standard best practices on a.o. Demand Planning, Supply Planning and S&OP as well as specific developments such as advanced optimization and AI forecasting to fit client-specific needs.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description:
**About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
  
  
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
  
  
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!
  
  
**Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.**
**Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To**
You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:
  
  

* Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.
* The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.
* Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.
* Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.
* Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

**What You Bring**
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.
* Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).
* High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.
* Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.
* Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.
* A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.
* You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.
* You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.
* You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.
* You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

**How You’ll Develop In This Role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
  
  

* Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.
* Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.
* Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

**The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
  
  
**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
  
  

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience
* Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
  
  
Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
  
  

* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**

* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Stock Keeper, Casa LOEWE Barcelona
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As a **Stoc** **k** **K** **eeper**you will be responsible for the activities of the Back of House , ensuring the creation of an environment wh ich allows efficiency, effectiveness, and excellence in routines and execution . You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house.
* Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies.
* Unpack all deliveries placing stock safely and correctly in its designated location
* Control and manage the transfer of stock to and from the store and the return of stock to the Warehouse.
* Support the flow of stock and packaging between the back and front of house, ensuring the right products are available on the shop floor to improve efficiency and client experience.
* Ensure the team are promptly informed of new stock arrivals
* Plan and support periodic and mini stock takes, investigate and communicate any discrepancies to your Manager.
* Process all paperwork, reports and general administration connected with stock management.
* Work with internal teams (Visual, Merchandising, Press) making available their product requests.
* Support and coordinate the aftersales process (repairs, alteration, etc) to ensure an excellent client experience.
* Fully integrate and participate in the store activities such as morning briefings, relevant training, etc.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

* A natural multitasker, well organised and calm when many things happen at once.

* Proactive and creative, someone who enjoys proposing and organising events.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

SLS Barcelona, a five-star urban resort of extraordinary experiences, brings a new variety of seaside glamour, indulgence and excellence to Barcelona’s waterfront district of Port Forum. Here the hallmarks of an SLS wonderland – playful ambiance, VIP treatment, and theatrical experiences - meet idyllic views to set a lavish stage for the extraordinary to unfold. The only 5-star hotel in the city to feature a terrace off every guestroom (471 in total), SLS Barcelona is all-encompassing in its delight, offering an array of exclusive amenities including rooftop dining and bars, three inviting swimming pools, a spacious 800 square-meter ballroom with abundant natural light, break out rooms catering to all size of meetings, a rejuvenating spa, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre. Say farewell to the ordinary, and hello to the extraordinary!

 **Job Description**

**What you’ll do**

We are looking for a Geneal Ledger Accountant to join the team at SLS Barcelona. Under the guidance of the Assistant Director of Finance, you’ll support the Finance department on the financial operations of the hotel while managing hotel assets and ensuring a centralized accounting environment.

  

* Maintains and consolidates all financial transactions in the general ledger.
* Ensures all assets are duly capitalized
* Ensures all necessary adjustments are done before month end
* Support internal and external audits
* Implement internal controls to prevent imbalances and ensure company procedures are in place
* Work closely with accounts payable and receivable teams to ensure timely postings
* Maintain Contract Log
* Resolve queries from suppliers
* Check vouchers, prepare payments and forward to FC for authorization.
* Perform or assist in the performance of month-end closing. Input General Ledger entries and journal vouchers as required. Ensure that appropriate supporting information is collated and submitted.
* Perform or assist in performing balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations and oversee the process of credit extension and collection of overdue accounts.
* Oversee internal hotel audits and report anomalies to management team and ensuring that audit policies and procedures (Control Self-Assessment) are being followed.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports in accordance with reporting calendars, ensuring that all reports are submitted on a timely basis.
* Conduct necessary procedures to meet all legal requirements

  
**Qualifications**

**What we are looking for...**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, business administration or related field.
* +2 years of experience in a hotel’s accounting department.
* Ability to multitask, work in a fast-paced environment and have a high-level attention to detail.
* Fluent in Spanish and English.
* You take ownership of important issues, solve problems, and make effective decisions.
* You learn quickly and adapt to SLS’s unique culture.
* You are humble and open to ideas. We leave our ego at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other and has fun along the way.

  
**Additional Information**

**What's in it for you...**

* The opportunity to join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations at every opportunity.
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.
* Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands.

SLS is part of Ennismore, a creative hospitality company rooted in culture and community, with a global collection of entrepreneurial and founder-built brands with purpose at their heart. Ennismore is a joint- venture with Accor, formed in 2021.

description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.

title: DTC Funnel Specialist & CRO
description:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on **CRO Lead** to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.

We spend **$2,000,000+ per month on Meta**, so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with **3–4+ years** running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.

### **The mission of this role**

Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.

### **Who are we?**

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

### **What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday** – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
* **Speed Is King** – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
* **Work Smart** – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
* **Overdeliver** – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

### **Outcomes (what success looks like)**

90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
* Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
* Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
* AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
* No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day

### **Key Objectives**

* Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
* Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
* Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
* Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
* Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
* Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
* Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, full-time
* Fluent in English
* CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must.
* Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up.
* Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages.
* Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help.
* Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency.
* Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule.
* Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* Bonus points: subscription or pet brand experience.

### **Accountabilities**

What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.

* CRO test plan and backlog – Keep one ranked test plan per brand, scored on impact, confidence and effort, so the highest-impact tests are always briefed and run next.
* Funnels – Run split tests on every paid-acquisition funnel each week, and build new funnels and landing pages that match our ad angles to lift conversion rate and RPV.
* Build, QA and launch tests – Brief our web developer and designer, QA every variant (tracking, prices, discount codes, mobile and desktop) and launch tests on time, every week.
* Results, winners and conversion monitoring – Call finished tests honestly, ship the winners, and catch any conversion drop the same day.
* CRO agency – Manage our CRO agency's test list, targets and results, and decide with the Head of Growth when the work moves in-house.
* CRO reporting and meetings – Report conversion rate, RPV, AOV, tests live and win rate weekly, and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

### **How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening

(2) Test Project

(3) Technical Interview

(4) Culture Fit Interview

### **Salary Expectation**

**USD $4,000 – $6,000+** per month (based on experience and expertise).

title: Associate Director - Investments
description:
This role is part of our Central M&A Team at saas.group.

**What is saas.group?**
-----------------------

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

**Profile Overview**
--------------------

Our Investment Team deploys $50M+ of capital a year into niche, bootstrapped PLG software companies across North America and Western Europe. These are capital-efficient, founder-built businesses that most funds overlook because they are too small, too founder-owned or too unconventional. We see the opportunity, and we operate what we buy.

We're hiring an Associate Director, Investments to sit in the principal seat. You'll report to our Head of M&A, work alongside an existing Associate Director and have significant exposure to our C-suite. As deal captain, you qualify the opportunity, make the first offer, build the investment case, set the price, negotiate with the founder, run diligence and take the deal to close. You won't be building pitch books or playing a supporting role, and you won't wait years to lead a deal of your own. Your judgement decides where our capital goes.

If you bring the commercial diligence skills or deal instincts of a lower mid-market PE or M&A team, and you want to own outcomes rather than advise on them, this is your role. You'll work directly with founders, our C-suite and the operators who scale the businesses you buy.

**Your impact in the first 6-12 months will be:**

* Own early-stage qualification: take new opportunities from first call to a non-binding offer quickly, kill weak ones early and turn the strongest into IC-ready investment cases.
* Earn the trust of founders, our C-suite and the operating teams who will run the businesses you buy.
* Step in as deal captain on your first live transactions and drive them from LOI to signed SPA.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Capital allocation:** Underwrite every deal you lead. Form a clear view on value, risk and returns, write the investment memo and defend your recommendation in front of our Investment Committee.
* **Qualification and offers:** Qualify new opportunities fast, kill weak ones early and issue non-binding offers on the ones worth pursuing. You set the price and structure that frame the deal all the way to LOI.
* **Deal captaincy:** Own the process end to end, from first call and non-binding offer through LOI, diligence and SPA to closing. You set the timeline, run the workstreams and own the outcome.
* **Commercial due diligence:** Lead our in-house CDD. Size the market, map the competition, define the right to win and get to the truth on quality of revenue: retention, concentration, pricing power and the durability of growth.
* **Financial and commercial modelling:** Build models from a blank sheet: ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, unit economics, scenarios, valuation and returns.
* **Negotiation:** Lead negotiations with founders and their advisors on price, structure and key terms, landing deals that work for the seller and for our returns.
* **Diligence leadership:** Run the full DD process across internal experts (finance, tech, product, marketing, legal, people) and external legal, financial and tax advisors, and turn their findings into decisions.
* **Stakeholder leadership:** Represent saas.group to sellers, brokers and advisors, and work hand in hand with our C-suite, leadership and the operators who take over after closing.
* **Coaching:** Develop the junior members of the team as a hands-on player-coach.

**What You bring to the table**
-------------------------------

* 6+ years of professional experience after university, with a strong track record in transactions, strategy or both.
* Training at a top-tier firm or team in one or more of:

* + **Private equity:** lower mid-market transactions, typically sub-$10M EBITDA, ideally in software or tech-enabled services.
  + **Strategy consulting:** MBB (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or leading strategy firms such as Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, L.E.K. Consulting, OC&C, Simon-Kucher or Arthur D. Little.
  + **Big Four strategy and deals:** Strategy& (PwC), EY-Parthenon, Deloitte (Monitor Deloitte / M&A) or KPMG Deal Advisory, especially in commercial due diligence.
  + **Corporate development / in-house M&A:** ideally at a high-velocity aggregator or buy-and-build strategic.
  + **Investment banking:** M&A advisory at mid-market or tech-focused boutique banks, ideally on lower mid-market transactions with enterprise values below $50M.

* **An investor's mindset:** you think like an owner, form a point of view quickly and back it with numbers.
* **Live deal experience:** you know what it takes to get a deal over the line, and ideally you've led workstreams or been the day-to-day deal lead.
* **Excellent financial modelling and valuation skills:** you build from a blank sheet and can defend every assumption.
* **A player-coach approach:** you have experience developing junior talent and enjoy doing it.
* **Real commercial due diligence experience:** market sizing, competitive analysis, customer and expert interviews, and quality-of-revenue work.
* **Presence:** you can negotiate with founders selling their life's work and hold your ground with the C-suite and advisors.
* **Rigorous project management:** you keep multiple parties, timelines and documents moving without dropping the ball.
* A genuine interest in software and **SaaS** business models. A software background is an advantage but not a requirement.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a plus.
* **Real AI fluency and the drive to put it to work**: you already use AI tools (Claude especially) day to day and look for ways they can speed up research, analysis, modelling and diligence workflows.

**What's in it for You**
------------------------

* **Principal seat, real ownership:** You'll lead deals and allocate capital as a principal, not an advisor, then watch the companies you bought grow inside our portfolio.
* **Deal flow and exposure:** $50M+ deployed every year across two continents, with direct access to our C-suite and Investment Committee from day one.
* **Ultimate flexibility:** We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
* **Freedom and autonomy:** We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
* **Minimum bureaucracy:** We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
* **Small & friendly team:** We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
* **Our network:** We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
* **Flexible time off:** We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

**International collaboration**  
You’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden and become part of a growing international team.

**Employee discounts**  
Enjoy attractive employee discounts across the Hatstore range.

**Annual wellness allowance**  
All employees receive an individual wellness allowance that can be used for activities such as sports and outdoor pursuits, or for spa, wellness and recovery.

**A growing and passionate organisation**  
Join us on an exciting growth journey where caps, creativity, entrepreneurship and people are at the heart of everything we do.

**Become part of Hatstore**
---------------------------

We’re looking for our next **Hatstar**, someone who wants to help make Hatstore a go-to destination for caps and headwear in Barcelona.

Does this sound like you? Apply today and become part of Hatstore’s international expansion.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Medical Director - Oncology , Sponsor Dedicated (12 Months Fixed Term Contract)
description:
Madrid, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1577094

  

**Job Overview**

The medical department consists of a Chief Medical Officer, Medical Directors, Sr Medical Directors, Medical Writers, and Safety Associates. The Medical Director provides medical and scientific support to clinical research programs, study teams and investigators. The Medical Director also provides review, advice, and leadership for potentially or awarded clinical research programs.

The Medical Director role is a team member participant role and functions in a matrix report to project teams much like other members of the project teams. The primary role of Medical Director is to provide medical oversight for clinical trials by serving as Medical Monitor for studies conducted by IQVIA Biotech Clinical on behalf of sponsor companies. The principal function of a Medical Monitor is to serve as primary contact for the sponsor medical team and to serve as front line medical resource to support the project team. The Medical Monitor is customarily available 24/7 to answer questions from site coordinators and investigators on protocol inclusion/exclusion criteria, protocol clarifications, and compliance issues, and to provide review of alert labs per sponsor preference. Major duties of the Medical Director are outlined below:

**Essential Functions**

Functions as project team member:

* Provides medical and scientific input to clinical research programs including review of new business proposals, preclinical and/or clinical data, study protocols, training materials, informed consent, Investigator Drug Brochures, eCRFs, analysis plan designs, clinical study reports, regulatory approval submissions, serious and non-serious adverse event evaluation, and reporting.
* Ensures medical activities run according to GCP and operate with highest efficiency.
* Establishes and maintains a network of medical/scientific consultants, etc.
* Supervises and manages Medical Director activities.

Clinical Activities:

* Interacts with clients regarding drug development programs, study design and protocol.
* Reviews and provides input for protocol development. Interacts with key thought leaders and/or sponsor representatives to develop inclusion/exclusion criteria and study endpoints.
* Interacts in team approach to develop statistical and data management sections of the protocol.
* Reviews the final protocol for clinical, safety and efficacy variables.
* Provides project team training on protocol and/or therapeutic areas.
* Assists team with developing criteria for investigator site selection and networking for potential investigators for study participation. Aids in review and final selection.
* Participates in subject recruitment and retention activities including individual calls to key opinion leaders, investigators, and site staff and/or participation in teleconference and WebEx presentations.
* Presents protocol and/or safety reporting information at investigator meetings.
* Develops project medical monitoring plans as requested.
* Provides on call coverage for protocol queries and site support.
* Provides first line contact for investigators and monitors regarding study related medical/safety issues and resolution of study protocol and patient eligibility issues.

Safety Monitoring and SAE Reporting Activities:

* Verifies the medical accuracy of patient safety data and maintains an ongoing assessment of the safety profile of the study.
* Provides medical review of SAE reporting, writes and/or reviews SAE narratives, and works with the Safety Management Department to track SAEs and follow-up on outstanding safety queries, interacts with sponsor and discusses safety issues with site as needed.
* Reviews IND/SUSAR Safety Reports (per sponsor preference), updates to Investigator Brochures, and annual IND reports with sponsor data.
* In consultation with the sponsor, follow procedures for acquiring knowledge of subject treatment assignments (i.e. breaking the blind).
* Interact with appropriate FDA officials concerning safety and other study related issues, as requested.

Data Activities:

* Provides medical review of eCRFs for clinical accuracy.
* Provides medical review of data analysis plan.
* Reviews safety fields at case freeze for reconciliation (if needed).
* Works with data group to reconcile SAE events as needed.
* Reviews medical coding of adverse events, laboratory data and concomitant medications for accuracy, coherence, consistency, and trends.
* Reviews data tables, listings, and figures.
* Reviews and/or writes portions of final clinical study report.

DSMB/Adjudication Committee Activities:

* May assist sponsor in choosing committee members.
* May serve as a non-voting member to convene and organize proceedings.
* May develop operating guidelines in conjunction with committee members and submits these to sponsor for review.
* May determine data flow with sponsor to ensure reporting accuracy.
* Can ensure DSMB feedback is given to sites for IRBs.
* All DSMB activities are usually managed by the IQVIA Biotech Oversight Management Group and not the IQVIA Biotech medical monitor.

Business Development Activities:

* Work with Business Development to actively solicit new business for Novella Clinical, including assistance with marketing presentations and proposal development.
* Supports business development activities with proposal development and sales presentations.
* Participates in feasibility discussions relating to specific project proposals.

Special Projects:

* Obtain literature searches to acquire background information for study proposals, preparation of training sessions, and interpretation of clinical data, report writing, etc.
* Assists with drafting of standard operating procedures and working practices regarding all Medical Director activities.
* Participate in a variety of team quality improvement efforts as necessary.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested by the Chief Medical Officer.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer

We are seeking an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong portfolio, exceptional design skills, and a passion for creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences.

This role is ideal for a designer with 5+ years of professional experience who is ready to take greater ownership of complex website projects, contribute to strategic design decisions, and help elevate the quality of work across the team.

As a Senior UX/UI Designer, you will independently lead the design execution of assigned projects, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity designs and developer handoff. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, developers, and other designers to deliver thoughtful, user-centered solutions that balance functionality, aesthetics, and client objectives.

You will also play an important role in maintaining high design standards, contributing to client presentations, and providing guidance and constructive feedback to fellow designers, without formal team management responsibilities.

Portfolio required for consideration.

### **Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of professional experience in a UX/UI design role, ideally at an agency or in a fast-paced, client-focused environment, with a strong portfolio showcasing intuitive, visually compelling, and user-centered digital experiences.
* You are proactive, highly organized, and capable of independently managing complex design assignments, balancing multiple priorities, and meeting deadlines.
* You have strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to articulate design decisions and explain your creative rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.
* You have a proficient level of English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
* You are highly proficient in Figma, with extensive experience in wireframing, prototyping, high-fidelity UI design, and scalable design systems.
* You have a strong understanding of UX/UI principles, information architecture, interaction design, and responsive design, paired with a keen eye for typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and detail.
* You have a solid understanding of web development principles, including HTML5, CSS3, front-end capabilities and limitations, and web accessibility standards (WCAG AA).
* You are a strategic and creative problem solver who can balance user needs, business objectives, and technical requirements to develop thoughtful design solutions.
* You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy giving and receiving constructive feedback, and are comfortable guiding fellow designers while remaining adaptable to other creative disciplines, including graphic and editorial design.

### **What You'll Do**

* Take ownership of the UX/UI design process for assigned website and digital projects, from initial discovery and concept development through final execution and developer handoff.
* Collaborate with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, designers, and developers to translate client objectives, project scopes, brand guidelines, and technical requirements into effective design solutions.
* Conduct design research and develop information architecture, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes to explore and validate design concepts.
* Design responsive, intuitive, and visually compelling websites and digital interfaces that balance usability, accessibility, visual storytelling, and business goals.
