title: Senior Amazon Content Strategist
description:
**About Us**  
Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms.

Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.  
As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C.

The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption.

A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms.

The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility.

**Tasks**
---------

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Content Audits & Quality Assessment**  

* Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short.
* Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements.
* Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy.

**Content Strategy Development**  

* Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus.
* Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour.
* Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category.
* Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on.
* Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction.

**AI & Agentic Discoverability**  

* AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search.
* Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations.
* Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery.

**Testing & Performance Monitoring**  

* A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent.
* Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation.
* Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy.

**Creative Briefing & Review**  

* Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and

marketplace advertising content.  

* Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction.
* Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery.

**Client Management**  

* Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders.
* Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams.
* Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements.
* Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice.
* Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business.

**Quality & Output Review**  

* Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy.

**AI-Enabled Working**  

* AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy.
* Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What You Bring to the Role**

* Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment.

* Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C.

* Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards.

* Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy.

* Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers.

* Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results.

* Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this.

* Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals.

* Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats.

* Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle.

* Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance.

* Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers.

**Desirable**

* Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms.

* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive.

* Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals.

* Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base.

**Benefits**
------------

**What We Offer**  

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Hybrid Working Model
* Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team
* Continuous learning & career development
* The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces

We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

**What You'll Architect**

You will join Intake, Keyrus' international Talent Acquisition team: a cross-border team that advises Keyrus entities worldwide, combining market intelligence with strategic recruitment to help leaders make smarter, data-driven hiring decisions. In this role, you combine advisory and sourcing skills, using AI-enabled tools and talent data to find, assess and attract the people who build intelligent systems for our clients.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

* Produce talent market insights on skills availability, salary trends, and competitor activity to guide where and how Keyrus hires

* Build and maintain talent pools in our core technologies, so entities can staff new client projects quickly

* Lead and deliver recruitment projects, managing the full recruitment cycle from intake to offer

* Run competency-based interviews that assess both technical depth in data and AI and consulting skills, with human judgment at the heart of every hiring decision

* Strengthening the Keyrus employer brand with data and AI communities through content, networking and community engagement

* Share your expertise in AI-enabled recruitment and help grow TA capabilities across the group

**Who You Are**

* You think beyond filling roles: you understand what the business is trying to achieve and recruit with that in mind

* You are a trusted advisor to senior leaders, confident enough to challenge a brief with data and propose alternatives

* You are fluent in the language of data and AI, and understand the roles you recruit for well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and consultants

* You use technology to work smarter, and you know where automation adds value and where a human conversation makes the difference

* You thrive in a cross-border team, working remotely across countries, cultures and markets

* You build genuine, long-term relationships with candidates and stakeholders

* You keep improving how we recruit, and share what works with the wider team

**What You Bring**

Qualifications/Certifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business, **Psychology,** or a related field, or equivalent by experience

* 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with a headhunting background

Technical Skills

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

* Final conversation with Intake leadership

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model (HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

Keyrus is listed on Euronext Growth Paris. (ALKEY – ISIN Code: FR0004029411 – Reuters: KEYR.PA – Bloomberg: ALKEY: FP).

For more information: www.keyrus.com

title: Global Medical Training Specialist
description:
**Location** Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain **Job ID** R-262841 **Date posted** 26/10/2026

  

**This is what you will do:**

Alexion operates as a matrix organisation committed to serving patients with rare diseases. The **Global Medical Training Specialist**, within the **Global Medical Training and Field Capabilities** organisation, will support the design, delivery and execution of high-quality learning and development initiatives for global and local medical teams. Working with therapeutic area and functional partners, you will translate learning needs into practical, engaging and compliant training solutions, coordinate delivery and continuously improve learner impact. Digital tools, including AI, will be used as a workbench to accelerate content development, strengthen learning design and improve efficiency, while business needs, learner experience and training quality remain the primary focus.

**You will be responsible for the following:**

* **Learning needs and planning:** Partner with therapeutic area and functional stakeholders to identify learning needs, clarify outcomes and build practical delivery plans aligned with medical priorities.

* **Learning design:** Design engaging, audience-appropriate learning experiences and materials using adult learning and instructional design principles across live, virtual and self-directed formats.

* **Delivery and facilitation:** Coordinate and deliver high-quality training sessions, workshops and learning programmes, including facilitator preparation, learner communications and delivery logistics.

* **Programme execution:** Manage assigned initiatives from brief through implementation, ensuring clear milestones, stakeholder alignment, compliant review, timely delivery and effective use of resources.

* **Launch readiness:** Support the development and execution of launch learning plans that build the knowledge, skills and confidence required by medical teams.

* **Quality and compliance:** Maintain high standards for scientific accuracy, learner experience, accessibility and compliance, identifying and resolving quality issues with relevant stakeholders.

* **Measurement and improvement:** Gather learner feedback and use available data to assess participation, effectiveness and opportunities to improve future learning interventions.

* **AI-enabled workbench:** Use approved AI and digital tools to support research, drafting, content adaptation, quality checks and learner personalisation, applying appropriate human oversight and company standards.

* **Therapeutic area focus:** Work within a specific therapeutic area under the guidance of the relevant Global Medical Director, while sharing approaches and learning across the wider medical training team to strengthen consistency and scale.

**You may be required to support the following tasks:**

* **Learning communications:** Develop clear, audience-focused communications that build awareness, readiness and participation in learning initiatives.

* **Learning platforms and resources:** Support the organisation, publication and maintenance of learning resources across approved platforms, ensuring materials remain current and easy to access.

* **Vendor and stakeholder coordination:** Coordinate inputs, timelines and deliverables with internal partners and external vendors to support efficient programme execution.

* **Training data and reporting:** Maintain accurate programme records and prepare concise updates on delivery status, participation, feedback and agreed measures of impact.

**You will need to have the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree and/or tertiary qualification in clinical science, education, learning and development or a related field.

* Minimum 12 months’ experience supporting the design, delivery or coordination of learning and development initiatives, preferably within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.

* Understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate learning objectives into practical, engaging training experiences.

* Strong organisation and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders and timelines.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working across diverse global and cross-functional teams.

* Comfort using digital learning tools and approved AI applications as part of day-to-day training design, development and delivery.

* Commitment to quality, accuracy, compliance and continuous improvement.

**We would prefer for you to have the following:**

* Experience supporting medical, scientific or launch learning programmes in a global matrix organisation.

* Experience with instructional design, facilitation, virtual learning or learning management systems.

* Practical experience using AI tools to improve the speed, quality or personalisation of learning content and workflows.

* Fluency in one or more additional languages to support global training initiatives.

**Date Posted**

27-oct-2026

**Closing Date**

16-nov-2026

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where every single person can belong because of their uniqueness. title: Solutions Marketing Manager (Remote)
description:
This role manages product marketing for document databases (MongoDB), MySQL, and MariaDB.  
  
Percona is fully remote, and open source in our identity.

**Location**: Remote (EMEA or Americas preferred, for core-hours overlap with the team)

**Reports to**: Director of Solutions Marketing (Solutions Marketing is Percona's product marketing function)

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Percona sells support, services, and expertise alongside database software. Our software and our services combine to provide users and customers with secure open source databases, free of vendor lock-in. On this team, we help communicate the value and relevance to the people involved in deciding to use our solutions. The right person for this role thinks in use cases and buyer needs, not only product features.

You don’t need to come from a product marketing background. If you've done technical content, developer relations, solutions engineering, or technical writing in the database or infrastructure space, and you can translate complex technology into clear messaging, we want to hear from you.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

Initial focus (document databases like MongoDB, MySQL, and MariaDB):

* Technical product messaging and positioning for Percona’s MongoDB related offerings, MySQL, and MariaDB support and expertise.
* Use case and value based messaging for all feature messaging for GTM
* Competitive positioning
* Partner with Services and Consulting so your messaging connects to the support, consulting, and managed services that customers actually buy alongside the software.

Across the portfolio (ongoing):

* Coordinate with Product on roadmap inputs for your portfolio areas. Translate VOC from support, consulting, and sales into positioning updates and product feedback
* Own launch plans for releases, features, and service offerings in your areas. Contribute to launches, enablement, and messaging that span multiple database technologies.
* Build and maintain competitive landscapes for your primary areas, and contribute to the broader Percona competitive view. Track ecosystem trends across your portfolio areas (community surveys, conferences, mailing lists, analyst reports).

* Build sales and CS enablement: competitive comparison docs, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQ docs, and other materials that connect technology to the use cases buyers care about.
* Engage with the open source database community. Represent Percona's perspective at events and in public content.

**Must-haves:**

* **Strong communicator.** Can write for technical buyers (DBAs, SREs, platform engineers) and economic buyers (VP Eng, CTO, CISO). Clear and concise internally too.
* **Stakeholder skills**. Builds trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Services. Responsive, organized, follows through.
* **Technical foundation**. Comfortable in technical conversations about databases, infrastructure, and operations. Can learn complex technology quickly and translate it into clear messaging. **Can work in, or can** ***learn*** **to work in GitHub**. Understanding of use cases that drive these buyers: migrations, high availability, performance, cost, compliance, and AI or vector workloads.
* **Open source mindset.** Understands transparent work, respects community, and describes licenses honestly, including when software is source-available rather than open source. Has worked in or engaged with open source in some meaningful way.
* **Adaptable.** Willing to work across multiple database technologies when the team needs it.
* 3+ years in a technical marketing, developer relations, solutions engineering, technical writing, or product marketing role. (The specific title matters less than what you've done.)

**How we work**
---------------

Percona is fully remote with a global team. Open source is the foundation: our software is built in the open where licenses allow, our community relationships are real, and transparency is the default.

You'll partner closely with teammates covering other database technologies and have direct access to Product, Engineering, Sales, and Consulting

Occasional travel (3-6 events a year) for database community conferences, partner meetings, and internal offsites (for example Percona Live, KubeCon, and MySQL or MongoDB community events).

**Compensation**
----------------

Competitive with market for remote-first infrastructure and open source companies. Adjusted for location. We share the salary range for this role early in the conversation.

**Why Percona?**

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!

Connect with us and stay up to date on our latest news and developments by following us on LinkedIn and Twitter. We look forward to connecting with you!

title: Director of Marketing - Falcon MLR
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

### **The Role**

We are seeking a **Marketing Director** to lead global marketing for Falcon MLR, our agentic MLR solution. Partnering closely with marketing, strategy, and product management, you will develop the positioning, messaging, value propositions, and go-to-market strategy for Falcon MLR. You will also execute global marketing strategies that drive brand awareness, pipeline growth, and engagement with existing customers and target accounts.

You will ensure seamless territory alignment and make a measurable impact across demand generation, events, communications, and digital marketing in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Develop and drive global marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Falcon MLR, aligning marketing initiatives with business objectives and market opportunities
* Own the integrated marketing strategy, partnering closely with cross-functional teams on key objectives and campaign themes
* Create awareness, nurture, and educate key contacts within target accounts to drive pipeline growth and accelerate sales opportunities
* Develop compelling marketing content—including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, webinars, and sales tools—to support every stage of the customer journey
* Partner with Product Management and Strategy to build differentiated positioning, messaging, and value propositions that speak directly to key target buyers and influencers
* Represent the voice of the customer by bringing market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback into product and marketing strategies
* Identify and act on opportunities to improve programs and ABM effectiveness through better audience segmentation, marketing techniques, and processes
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Enablement, Strategy, and Marketing teams to ensure optimal orchestration and execution of global marketing programs
* Build and maintain a complete and accurate account and contact database
* Measure marketing performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve awareness, pipeline, and customer adoption

### **Requirements**

* 10+ years of enterprise B2B software marketing experience
* Must have a proven track record of building global, multi-channel campaigns and driving strategic go-to-market execution
* Hands-on experience spanning GTM strategy development through content creation and editing (including customer stories, presentations, web content, videos, and sales tools)
* Deep understanding of database management, audience segmentation, and targeted nurture programs (including ABM) to accelerate pipeline growth and sales opportunities
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships and drive alignment across multiple product lines (PromoMats, Medical, MedTech) and matrixed global regions (NA & EU, LATAM, APAC)
* Experience leading end-to-end integrated marketing programs across product launches, field programs, demand generation, webinars, events, and sales enablement
* Demonstrated experience defining success metrics, tracking campaign performance, evaluating business impact, and continuously optimizing programs based on data and customer insights

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience marketing high-value solutions to the life sciences industry
* Experience with Marketo

### **Interviewing with Veeva**

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party, unless you have already completed it with Veeva previously.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

  + A conversation with the hiring manager
  + A practical case exercise
  + A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

### **Compensation**

* Total compensation: 90,000 - 150,00 EUR
* The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent\_accommodations@veeva.com.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers.

Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel.

This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness.

This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons.

As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization.

This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel.

Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.

**Education and Experience**

**Required:**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

* Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.

* Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.

* Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups

* Executes email marketing, and display advertising.

* Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.

* Verifies all advertising for the hotel in digital channels is in alignment with brand voice.

**Social Media Content Management**

* Develops and executes promotions campaign in F&B, weddings, spa, rooms and conferences through relevant digital and social media channels.

* Engages in proactive online reputation management by surfacing relevant guest comments (positive or negative) in social media channels and responds accordingly.

**Public Relations and Visual Asset Management**

* Develops a comprehensive PR plan per quarter along with agency and and executes post sign-off from GM.

* Maintains a comprehensive list of local media contracts, with particular emphasis on food critics and bloggers.

* Manages assigned accounts as per the media account management system.

* Writes and distributes all press releases for property events, promotions, and outlets.

* Manages the execution of hotel sponsored events, community/government relations activities, and press promotional activities.

* Supports pull through of impactful PR strategy & activities to drive quality press coverage through media engagement, in alignment with communications objectives.

* Verifies the news clippings and other online, print, and social media mention report is completed on a monthly basis for property distribution.

* Manages external vendors and media agencies; works with agency partners and continent PR leader to identify strategic media buys for their hotel(s).

* Surfaces and vets PR leads from the continent PR Leader regarding which are the best media to promote the hotel.

* Supports the co-ordination of photography for F&B advertising, collateral and public relations purposes between the hotel, advertising agency and the regional field marketing teams.

* Manages photo shoots for seasonal or festive promotions in partnership with the cluster or area marketing team.

* Acts as central point of contact for regionally approved local photographers for food, amenity, and property imagery; coordinates with area or cluster marketing to verify all photography adheres to brand voice.

**Direct Marketing and Collateral Development**

* Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.

* Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.

* Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.

* Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.

title: Senior User Acquisition Manager, Meta & Google Ads (US Degree Programs)
description:
TripleTen is a leading online coding bootcamp that offers to learn coding and data analysis skills for tech industry jobs in less than a year in the US, Latin America, and Brazil.

Our research-based learning method is focused on ensuring that after completing our program, every student, regardless of their initial abilities, will find employment in tech industry with 100% money-back guarantee and 87% employment rate among our 6K+ graduates.

We are looking for a **Senior User Acquisition Manager** to launch and scale paid acquisition for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities. You will own acquisition from the first ad impression through to enrollment, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads, particularly YouTube, is a strong plus.

  
Requirements:  
  
  

* 4+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with recent hands-on experience managing both **Meta Ads and Google Ads**, including audience acquisition through YouTube.
* Experience in acquisition-first or paid-marketing-first companies, where paid acquisition is a core driver of revenue.
* Proven success acquiring customers for **high-ticket B2C products** through multi-step funnels involving qualification, consultations, and sales conversations. Experience with products priced at $10,000+ is strongly preferred.
* Experience personally managing monthly advertising budgets of **$50,000–$100,000 or more**, with measurable business results.
* A track record of launching acquisition from scratch: setting up accounts and tracking, testing initial hypotheses, finding effective combinations of audiences, offers, and creatives, and scaling them.
* Strong hands-on Meta Ads expertise, including campaign structure, audience testing, pixel and conversion setup, creative experimentation, and budget optimization.
* Hands-on Google Ads expertise beyond Search, particularly YouTube and video-led acquisition for products that require consideration and demand generation.
* Full-funnel analytical skills: you work with CAC, ROMI, lead-to-call and call-to-sale conversion rates, and use CRM and BI data to assess performance beyond cost per lead.
* Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking. You can define conversion events and validate tracking, collaborating with analysts and engineers when needed.
* Experience testing offers, ad copy, creatives, and landing pages, and writing clear briefs for designers, content producers, and external partners.
* Confidence working independently in a new product environment, with limited historical data and no established acquisition playbook.
* AI tools are already part of your day-to-day workflow.
* Full professional English.
* Based within **CET ±3 hours**, with at least **2 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time**.

  
Brand:
  
TripleTen  
  
What you will do:
  

* Launch paid acquisition from scratch for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities.
* Own acquisition strategy, budgets, and hands-on campaign execution, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads and YouTube will allow you to test and develop these channels as well.
* Build, test, and scale acquisition funnels for a high-ticket B2C product, from the first ad impression through qualification, consultations, and enrollment.
* Optimize for qualified prospects and customer acquisition cost, using CRM data, sales call transcripts, and conversion rates across the funnel to guide decisions.
* Develop and rapidly test hypotheses around audiences, messaging, offers, creative formats, and landing pages. Scale what works and stop what doesn’t.
* Turn audience research and competitor insights into actionable creative briefs. Work with the team and external partners to produce and iterate on ads and landing pages.
* Set up advertising accounts, pixels, conversion events, and campaign tracking, with support from analytics and engineering teams where needed.
* Work closely with Sales to improve lead quality and build a qualified waitlist ahead of the opening of paid enrollment.

  
What we can offer you:
  

* Competitive compensation.
* Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
* A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
* All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

title: Generative Content Creator
description:
**Moon Active**, a leading global mobile game developer entertaining millions worldwide, is seeking a highly skilled and creative **Generative Content Creator** to join the in-house video creative team of our Marketing Art Studio.

In this role, you will own video ad creatives end to end, from brief to delivery, across our portfolio: Coin Master, Travel Town, Reality Bay, Family Bay and more. You will create everything from scroll-stopping hooks and gameplay mechanics to rich narrative storytelling ads, at the pace and volume performance marketing demands.

You will direct generative tools (such as **Seedance, Kling, Veo, Nano Banana 2, ChatGPT Image 2, ComfyUI, Suno, ElevenLabs**, and others) alongside **After Effects and Photoshop**, combining the speed of AI with the storytelling fundamentals that make a shot work.

Apply today if you are passionate about video, storytelling, gaming and cutting-edge tech!

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own Video Ads End to End: Take a brief and run it on your own, from concept, art and AI generation through sound, edit and delivery, across gameplay-driven ads, story-driven narratives, scroll-stopping hooks and reskins.
* Learn What Wins: Study our ads' performance data alongside market trends and competitor creatives, and turn those insights into stronger hooks, angles and fresh ideas for every brief.
* Maintain Brand Consistency: Ensure all AI-generated output strictly adheres to each game's visual style guide, character roster, quality standards, brand identity and IP/copyright guidelines.
* Stay Ahead of AI Advancements: Research, test and bring emerging image, video and audio models to the team to continuously speed up our creative workflows.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Hands-On Video Production Experience: 3+ years of practical, professional work making video: shooting, animating, designing motion, building 3D or editing real productions from start to finish.
* Expertise in Generative Video and Image: Hands-on experience with platforms like Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Nano Banana 2 and ChatGPT Image 2, or similar. You translate film fundamentals (shot types, lenses, camera moves, lighting and action beats) into precise AI generations.
* Adobe Finishing Skills: Strong command of After Effects for basic compositing, stitching shots, quick fixes, layers, masking, tracking and color; Premiere for timeline and editing work; and Photoshop for art and image work.
* Strong Creative Fundamentals: A deep feel for story, timing and emotion, and a solid grasp of color, composition, lighting and anatomy to spot and fix imperfections in AI outputs.
* Adaptive, Independent Mindset: A dynamic, out-of-the-box problem solver who adapts quickly as tools evolve, runs their work without waiting to be told and hits deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ownership and Team Communication: Takes personal responsibility for every deliverable, raises issues early, and communicates clearly and openly with teammates, Leads and Creative Producers.

**Advantages**
--------------

* Node-Based AI Pipelines: Experience building custom pipelines in ComfyUI for precision that presets can't give.
* Building Your Own Tools: Familiarity with Claude Code, Cursor or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript) to automate pipelines and speed up production.
* 3D Software and AI Integration: Familiarity with Blender, Cinema 4D or Maya, and incorporating 3D assets into AI pipelines.
* Game UI and Gameplay Motion: Ability to create mock gameplay, game UI and interactive mechanics using a mix of AI generation and After Effects motion graphics.
* Performance Marketing Experience: A background in UA video ads or marketing creatives for mobile games.

* Ability to work under pressure with minimum supervision
* Customer-centric approach to delivery and problem solving
* Good knowledge of ITIL service management methodology

* Experience with Hyper Converged Infrastructure or Software Defined Storage solutions isan advantage

* Experience with service reporting and business analytics

The company develops consumer-facing financial products covering account funding, cards, onboarding, identity verification, KYC, and real-time balances on top of its own payments and settlement infrastructure.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**About the role**
------------------

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.
* Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.
* Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.
* Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.
* Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.
* Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.
* Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

  + **Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP:** REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).
  + **NetSuite:** SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.
  + **JD Edwards EnterpriseOne:** AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.
* A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.
* Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.
* A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.
* Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).
* Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.
* Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

**Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer**
-------------------------------------------------------

**We hire at both levels.** Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

**Integration Engineer**

* **Years:** 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.
* **Breadth:** in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.
* **Coaching:** you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.
* **Scope:** you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

**Senior Integration Engineer**

* **Years:** 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.
* **Breadth:** integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.
* **Coaching:** you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.
* **Scope:** you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

**Why BLP**

* **Real impact:** your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.
* **Breadth:** Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.
* **Growth:** fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.
* **Team:** regular team events.

Practical information

* **Location:** our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.
* If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.
* **Employment:** full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

description:

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.
