title: Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )
description:
**Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )**

Seen & Heard is a global creative agency with studios in Newcastle and London, delivering design, video production, creative communication and brand adaptation for global brands. Now we're going further. This is a brand-new role and a rare opportunity for a designer who's ready to step up, take the lead and shape how great creative lands across an entire region.

**THE ROLE**

As Regional Design Producer Lead, you'll be the **guardian of cultural and creative relevance** for your region. Global marketing toolboxes and their localisations are created in our UK design hub. Your mission is to make sure that work doesn't just arrive in your markets, it truly lands.

This is a Design Producer role first. Creative judgement and output sit at its heart, with project management running alongside. Yes, there's plenty of coordination, and you'll need to be brilliantly organised to do it well. But the real magic is this: looking at an asset built for everyone, knowing instantly how it will and won't work in your markets, and directing what needs to change. That cultural instinct is exactly why this role lives in the region, not the hub.

You'll also be the person who brings the region together. Markets get what they need faster, and for less, when their requirements arrive as one set rather than one at a time. You'll pull those requirements together, sharpen them along the way and get them in on time, then make sure the finished work gets back out to the markets just as smoothly.

This is leadership without line management: you'll lead through influence, expertise and great creative judgement. It's the perfect next step for a designer with a strong creative eye who's ready to start delivering through others, and who wants to grow with our business. You'll embody our values of **curiosity**, **partnerships**, **insight**, **agility** and **integrity**, and solve problems through beautiful design, rather than treating design as just an output.

**Where you'll fit in**

You'll report directly to a Director.

You'll partner closely with the client's creative operations lead for your region. They own the workflow, approvals, budgets and reporting. Within all of that, you're the one who **owns brief quality, cultural judgement and market consolidation**.

You'll also be part of a growing network of regional producers. They're your peers, with no reporting line either way: the people you'll swap ideas with, cover for and build a genuine support network alongside.

Expect two to three days a week in the client's office in the region, with the rest of the week working from home. And because this role is brand new, you'll have room to help shape exactly what that looks like as working relationships in the region settle.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cultural Relevance**

This is the heart of the role, and the part that simply can't be done from the UK. It's why you'll be based in the region.

* Alongside the marketing teams in the countries, decide what adapts, what has to be made from scratch, and what is not right for a market at all.
* Check what comes out of the hub for cultural fit, inside the hub’s quality gate rather than as another approval on the end of it.
* Say when something will not work, say why, and say what would. Flagging a problem without an answer is a job half done.
* Hold a position when a market asks for something that would damage the work or the brand, and know when to concede.
* Know what is going on in the region. Retail landscape, salon landscape, competitors, language, trends and what the markets are reacting to.

**Markets and Briefs**

Every market in the region briefs through you, making you the region's creative gatekeeper. A half-finished brief costs everyone time, so you'll set the bar for brief quality and make sure every brief that reaches the hub is ready to fly.

* Be the contact for the markets in the region, and build relationships with them that go further than email.
* Quality-gate every brief before it reaches the hub. Push back, and help markets get a brief to the point where it can be worked on.
* Refuse variations that are off-brand, inappropriate or not worth what they cost. Explain why rather than simply saying no.
* Consolidate requirements so the hub gets one set from the region rather than several. These requirements need to land alongside the other regions as the model expands so scale can be leveraged in the hub.
* Coordinate with the global team what the markets keep asking for, so the next toolbox has it built in.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Producing or managing creative work across more than one market, in an agency, a brand, an in-house studio or a market team.
* Working inside established creative or operational systems, and adapting them for market or business unit.
* Running briefs/requirements and stakeholders across several countries or departments.
* Running feedback and approval rounds to a deadline, and holding people to them.
* Creative automation or AI-assisted production/operations, hands-on and current, with a clear view of what AI does well and where it does not add value.
* Reporting on volumes, progress and spend accurately and on time.
* Fluent English, and fluent in the language of the country this role is based in.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Creative judgement. Can look at a piece of work and say why it will not land in a market, and what would.
* Able to hold a position with a market, with the hub or with a client colleague, and to know when to concede.
* Highly organised. Several markets converge on this role and nothing can be allowed to fall through it.
* Comfortable being the only Seen & Heard person in the room, being able to represent the company and the work.
* Clear about the difference between a preference and a problem.
* Writes a brief someone can start work from.
* Generous with what they know, and curious about markets other than their own.

**DESIRABLE**

* A design background, and enough hands-on Adobe Creative Cloud to make a small amend without asking.
* Conversational skills in additional languages from the region.
* Beauty, fashion or FMCG background, and an understanding of salon and retail.
* Experience of a hub-and-spoke or centralised production model, from either end of it.
* Localisation or transcreation specifically, rather than general production.
* Working knowledge of a DAM or creative workflow platform.
* Experience of a business going through growth or structural change.

**What we offer**

* **Pension:** 3% matched contribution
* **Holiday:** 23 days plus bank holidays, with time off between Christmas and New Year guaranteed
* **Sick pay:** 5 days at full pay each year
* **Flexible working:** hybrid options that work for you and the team
* **Wellbeing:** free gym classes in Newcastle and rooftop sauna access in London
* **Learning and development:** monthly lunch-and-learns, plus funding and time off for relevant courses

**READY TO LEAD?**

If you're a designer who's ready to step into leadership, bring creative judgement to a whole region and help shape a brand-new role from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

title: LEATHER DEVELOPMENT & SOURCING MANAGER
description:
### **Position**

Are you an expert in luxury leather craftsmanship with a passion for driving innovation and speed-to-market? We are looking for a **Leather Development & Sourcing Manager** to join our Development team.

In this pivotal role, you will bridge creative vision and technical execution, translating design briefs into proprietary brand signatures while maintaining the highest standards of quality, sustainability, and efficiency.

### **Job responsibilities**

  

* **Drive Rapid Development & Innovation:** Spearhead end-to-end development cycles from the initial design brief to industrialization, successfully optimizing innovation lead times while maintaining strict adherence to the collection milestone calendar without quality degradation.
* **Translate Creative Vision into Brand Signatures:** Direct exclusive touch, finishes, color depth, and natural aging characteristics, ensuring high first-time-right color and handfeel approval rates and consistent Maison signature finishes across bulk production.
* **Quality Assurance & Technical Validation:** Balance acceleration in time-to-market with rigorous technical validation, comprehensive testing, quality assurance, and root-cause analysis for leather behavior in handbag construction.
* **Supplier Management & ESG Integration:** Lead supplier management, negotiation, and cross-functional decision-making while embedding robust ESG practices, full traceability, and regulatory compliance into daily operations.

### **Profile**

* 15+ years of proven experience in leather development, research, and tanning within a fast-paced luxury environment.
* Deep knowledge of tanning, finishing, grading, and leather behavior in handbag construction. A strong eye for luxury aesthetics, handfeel, grain, and color nuance.
* Exceptional communication, high cross-functional influence, and the ability to seamlessly translate creative briefs into precise technical specifications.
* Fluency in English and Spanish are a must; knowledge of Italian and/or French is a strong advantage.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

Are you ready to shape the future of luxury leather goods? Apply now!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Bid Manager Cross-Solutions
description:
**Descripción de la empresa**

En Devoteam somos *Creative Technologists*. Somos una empresa líder en consultoría digital y tecnológica en Europa, especializada en Cloud, Ciberseguridad, Data y plataformas tecnológicas (partners estratégicos de AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, ServiceNow y Salesforce). Nuestro objetivo es dar forma a la tecnología para crear valor para nuestros clientes, transformando sus negocios de principio a fin.

 **Descripción del empleo**

Buscamos un/a **Bid Manager Transversal (Cross-Solutions)** para unirse a nuestro equipo. En este rol, serás la pieza clave encargada de orquestar y gestionar propuestas complejas que abarquen **todo el portfolio de soluciones de Devoteam**.

No te limitarás a una sola tecnología; tu misión será integrar piezas de Cloud, Data, Ciberseguridad o plataformas empresariales para crear propuestas de valor globales, coherentes y ganadoras. Trabajarás como "director/a de orquesta" junto a los equipos de Ventas, Centros de Excelencia (distintas áreas técnicas), Legal y Finanzas, garantizando la máxima calidad en todo el ciclo de vida de la licitación (RFI, RFP, RFQ).

Responsabilidades Clave

* **Gestión End-to-End de Licitaciones Complejas:** Liderar el proceso completo de elaboración de ofertas multidisciplinares, desde la fase de calificación (Go/No-Go) hasta la presentación final.
* **Orquestación Multi-Solución:** Coordinar a diferentes líderes técnicos, arquitectos y expertos de distintas unidades de negocio (AWS, Google, Microsoft, Cyber, Data) para consolidar sus aportaciones en un relato único y sin fisuras.
* **Diseño de la Estrategia Ganadora (Win-Theme):** Colaborar con Ventas para definir propuestas de valor transversales, diferenciadores estratégicos y modelos de *pricing* integrados.
* **Elaboración y Armonización de Documentación:** Redactar, estructurar y unificar el tono de la propuesta. Asegurar que las diferentes partes técnicas fluyan como una solución integral, cumpliendo con las necesidades del cliente y los estándares visuales de Devoteam.
* **Control de Tiempos y Riesgos:** Crear y gestionar un cronograma riguroso que alinee a todas las áreas involucradas, garantizando las entregas a tiempo y mitigando riesgos en proyectos de gran escala.
* **Apoyo en Defensa de Ofertas:** Ayudar a preparar las defensas orales, asegurando que el equipo (compuesto por múltiples perfiles) presente una visión conjunta y cohesionada ante el cliente.
* **Capitalización del Conocimiento:** Mantener y optimizar los repositorios de contenido "cross", creando plantillas modulares que faciliten la integración de diferentes tecnologías en futuras ofertas.

Requisitos

* **Experiencia:** Mínimo de 3 a 5 años trabajando como Bid Manager, Proposal Manager o Project Manager de Preventa en empresas de consultoría IT o integradores de sistemas. Se valorará especialmente la experiencia gestionando ofertas grandes y multidisciplinares.
* **Visión Holística IT:** Capacidad para entender el "Big Picture" tecnológico. No necesitas ser un experto técnico profundo en una sola área, pero debes comprender cómo interactúan el Cloud, los Datos, la Seguridad y las aplicaciones empresariales.
* **Liderazgo y Gestión de Stakeholders:** Habilidad demostrada para liderar por influencia, movilizar a equipos técnicos diversos y mediar entre diferentes áreas de negocio para lograr un objetivo común.
* **Gestión del Tiempo y Trabajo Bajo Presión:** Excelente capacidad organizativa para manejar múltiples piezas móviles y cumplir con *deadlines* estrictos.
* **Habilidades Comunicativas:** Capacidad de redacción excepcional (storytelling aplicado a negocio IT) y dotes de comunicación persuasiva.
* **Idiomas:** Español nativo/bilingüe y un nivel alto de Inglés (C1) indispensable para coordinarse con Centros de Excelencia internacionales y responder a RFP globales.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

* **Impacto Estratégico:** Un rol visible y fundamental para el crecimiento de la compañía, trabajando en los proyectos de transformación digital más grandes y complejos.
* **Crecimiento Profesional:** Plan de carrera estructurado y oportunidades de desarrollo en una compañía internacional en plena expansión.
* **Formación Continua:** Acceso a formación transversal y certificaciones de nuestros partners estratégicos (Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, etc.).
* **Flexibilidad:** Modelo de trabajo híbrido, horario flexible y medidas de conciliación.
* **Beneficios Sociales:** Retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tickets guardería) y actividades de *team building*.
* **Cultura:** Un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, innovador y dinámico, rodeado de talento multidisciplinar.

title: Senior Social Affiliates Manager (Marketing Brand III)
description:
¿Te apasionan los viajes, la cultura, el ocio y tienes ganas de participar en el crecimiento de la empresa Nº 1 en actividades, excursiones y tours en español por todo el mundo? Somos un equipo dinámico, multicultural e innovador, que entiende cada día como un desafío y una nueva oportunidad para crecer junto con la empresa.

En Civitatis, nuestra misión es que millones de viajeros de todo el mundo descubran y disfruten experiencias inolvidables. Serás el responsable de convertir a los creadores de contenido y afiliados en un canal de crecimiento rentable: definirás la estrategia de afiliación social, negociarás con los perfiles clave de cada mercado y responderás de su contribución en Net Revenue. Trabajarás de la mano del Head of Brand, Performance, Supply y Finance para que cada euro invertido en creadores construya marca y genere ventas medibles. Es un rol hands-on: harás tú mismo la prospección, el outreach, la negociación y la firma de creadores, con YouTube como canal principal.

En tu primer año, éxito es:

* 90 días: modelo de remuneración, contrato tipo y tracking funcionando; primeros creadores firmados en España y primeros vídeos publicados.
* 6 meses: una red de creadores activa en España y LATAM, publicando de forma constante, y un canal que ya recupera la inversión en ventas.
* 12 meses: programa activo en los 4 mercados, con contenido en español y portugués, rentabilidad creciente y un modelo self-serve en marcha para escalar con creadores más pequeños.

**¿Cómo será tu día a día?**

* **Estrategia de afiliación social:** diseñar y ejecutar la hoja de ruta de afiliación con creadores a 12–24 meses. Captar y cerrar creadores: identificar, contactar, negociar y firmar creadores por destino y mercado, priorizando YouTube (integraciones y vídeos evergreen que venden durante meses) e Instagram como canal secundario.
* **Modelos de inversión que se paguen solos:** diseñar y ajustar la remuneración (CPA, fee + comisión, incentivos por objetivos, códigos) para que cada euro invertido se recupere en NR.
* **Tracking y pagos:** asegurar que cada venta se atribuye bien (links en descripción, códigos, panel de afiliados) y que los pagos a creadores salen a tiempo y sin errores.
* **Reporting de NR:** medir y reportar NR, coste por venta y ROI por creador, mercado y formato, y decidir dónde escalar y dónde cortar.
* **Escalar el volumen:** montar el programa self-serve y los procesos que permitan llegar a la cola de creadores pequeños sin gestionarlos uno a uno.
* **Colaborarás con:** Tech (evolución del panel de afiliados y de Civitatis Creators), Supply (huecos de catálogo detectados a través de los creadores), Social y Diseño (coherencia de marca), Legal (contratos y etiquetado de contenido) y Finance (presupuesto y medición).

**¿Qué buscamos?**

* **Experiencia:** Más de 7 años de experiencia profesional, con al menos 4 años especializados en afiliación o creator marketing gestionados con objetivos directos de revenue.
* **Track record imprescindible:** Haber lanzado un programa de afiliación con creadores desde cero, aportando datos demostrables (número de creadores firmados, tiempos de ejecución y revenue generado).
* **Formación:** Titulación universitaria en Marketing, ADE o áreas similares (muy valorable formación de máster o postgrado).
* **Impacto en negocio:** Historial demostrado en la gestión y escalado de canales de afiliación con responsabilidad sobre Net Revenue (NR) o GMV propio.
* **Negociación internacional:** Experiencia negociando directamente con creadores de contenido y redes de afiliados a nivel multi-mercado.
* **Herramientas y plataformas:** Dominio de plataformas de afiliación (*Awin, Impact, CJ, Partnerize* o similares) y herramientas de gestión de creadores (*CreatorIQ, Upfluence, GRIN* o similares).
* **Conocimiento técnico:** Manejo sólido de modelos de atribución, sistemas de tracking analítico y prevención de fraude en afiliación.
* **Valoraremos muy positivamente (Plus):** Experiencia previa en el sector *travel* / OTA o *e-commerce*, así como conocimiento y gestión en mercados de LATAM.

**¿Por qué Civitatis?**

* Formarás parte del líder mundial de reserva online de excursiones y visitas guiadas en español.
* Espíritu joven, viajero y gran ambiente de trabajo. ¡+20 nacionalidades!
* Hay vida más allá del trabajo: Flexibilidad horaria (gestionas tu horario de entrada y salida), jornada intensiva en verano, modalidad de trabajo híbrida, así como otras medidas de conciliación.
* ¡24 días laborables de vacaciones! ¿Necesitas más descanso o tiempo para ti? Con Cividías, puedes comprar días extra de vacaciones cada año.
* Eventos de teambuilding (afterworks, torneos de pádel, fútbol, tours, fiestas, concursos, etc.)
* Planes voluntarios de retribución flexible para sacar el máximo partido a tu salario.
* ¡Equipo sano, equipo feliz! Tenemos fruta siempre a mano en la oficina y co-financiamos el gimnasio‍️.
* Nunca dejarás de aprender: planes de desarrollo, formación continua y clases de inglés con profesores nativos.
* Podrás disfrutar de nuestras más de 90.500 actividades con un super descuento.
* Trabajarás en el corazón de Madrid. Oficinas en plena Gran Vía.
* En Civitatis impulsamos la diversidad y la igualdad de oportunidades, valorando el talento y el potencial de cada persona. Esta oferta está abierta a todas las personas que cumplan con el perfil profesional requerido.

title: Senior Ads Measurement Partner
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

**Our Team**

The core Netflix Ads team is charged with building a new, best-in-class ads organisation to establish Netflix as the go-to platform for advertiser partners. The Netflix Ads measurement team is tasked with building industry-leading research for advertisers in support of our broader advertising sales efforts. This role is specifically for Spain.

  
  

Netflix Ads in Spain has seen amazing growth since its launch, and there has never been a more exciting time to get involved.

  
  

**Summary**

Netflix’s Ads Spain Measurement team is looking for a new Ads Measurement Lead to join the team. The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, consumer insights, data science, and our vendor partners. If you are someone who has experience taking independent action, demonstrating strong attention to detail, and working effectively in a collaborative environment, Netflix may be the place for you. For an insider's look at Netflix’s culture, make sure to read Seeking Excellence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce research and insights that tell the Spanish Netflix Ads story to the marketplace and advertiser clients through audience insights and campaign measurement results.
* Lead full-funnel measurement initiatives, including Reach & Frequency, BLS, and Attention, to guide clients on optimising their investment in Netflix Ads.
* Lead exploratory lower-funnel initiatives, such as syndicated MMMs, Conversion Lift, and 1P developments.
* Lead integration projects through interaction with Product teams and third-party vendors.
* Collaborate with the Head of Measurement as a supporting SME for Live events and measurement capabilities in ES.
* Partner with advertisers to establish strategic learning agendas and category playbooks.
* Oversee product and engineering project management for technical audience measurement integrations and API deployments.
* Drive upskilling sessions and set cross-functional strategy for Insights, Audience, and Full-Funnel measurement across the team.
* Act as an expert on TV/Video and Digital audience metrics, staying ahead of industry standards to ensure Netflix’s practices remain best-in-class.
* Develop meta-analyses and case studies based on full-funnel tests and audience insights for the Spanish market.
  

  

**Experience & Skills**

* At least 6 years of experience in media research at a streaming, agency, advertiser, or digital media company.
* Strong understanding of methodology, data, and systems from research providers, as well as direct digital technology and analytics.
* Experienced in effectiveness measurements such as Reach & Frequency, Incremental lift, Brand lift, Matched-Market testing, A/B testing, Marketing Mix Models and bespoke campaign effectiveness studies.
* Proficient in Spanish and English with effective communication skills.
* Strong knowledge of the advertising landscape, across all kinds of media channels and methods of buying.

title: Senior FX Product Manager - Hedging Conversion
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**FX Senior Product Manager - Hedging conversion**

**Ebury Madrid Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week**

As Ebury scales globally, we are evolving from a delivery-led organisation into a **platform-led product** company - building shared foundations that allow teams to move faster, operate safely in regulated environments and deliver high-quality client experiences across channel

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to own one number: the share of Ebury's clients who convert into hedgers — and to build the journeys, workflows and decision tools that get them there.

Ebury has a real hedging business. Thousands of clients already hedge with us, they're our most valuable and stickiest, and Hedge works. The problem isn't proof of concept — it's rate. For every client who converts, several more carry the same currency exposure, would benefit from the same forward, and never get there.

Here's the honest reason why. Hedging isn't a product you sell; it's a conclusion a client reaches once they can see what their international business is actually exposed to. Today that seeing happens in a CPM's head and a spreadsheet, one client at a time. The client can't see their own exposure clearly, the CPM can't see it at scale, and so the conversation that should be obvious either happens late or never happens at all.

This role builds the layer that changes that: guided journeys and lifecycle workflows that carry a client from unaware exposure to a first hedge to a standing policy — and the decision tools that let both the client and their CPM understand the client's international business well enough to make the right call, not just the next call.

You'll sit at the intersection of product, data, and commercial, working closely with:

* CPMs and Sales teams who convert clients today
* Data and Analytics
* Design and Engineering
* Compliance and Risk
* Clients directly

**What you'll do**

You will own the end-to-end conversion journey into hedging, backed by a dedicated squad of developers, including:

**Journeys & Lifecycle Workflows**

* The path from spot client Hedge-active policy client, and every drop-off point along it
* Guided, staged journeys rather than one-off prompts: the right message, to the right client, at the moment their exposure is real to them
* Triggered workflows off real events, a new currency pair, a large invoice, a rate move against them, a forward maturing
* Understanding what separates the clients who convert from the ones who don't, and building for the difference

**Decision Tools for Clients**

* Showing a client what their international business is actually exposed to, in their own numbers and their own currencies
* Exposure views, scenario and impact modelling, MTM and forward comparisons a finance lead can act on without training
* Turning "should I hedge?" into a question the client can answer for themselves, with confidence
* Balancing honesty about risk against simplicity of decision, the goal is a well-made decision, not a sold one

**Tooling for CPMs**

* Giving CPMs a portfolio-level view of client exposure, trades and performance, so they know who to talk to and what to say before the client asks
* Surfacing the signals that make a conversation timely: unhedged exposure, changing trade patterns, policy lapses
* Learning from the conversations that already convert clients, and productising them

**Repeat Hedging & Policy**

* Turning a first hedge into a second and a third
* Moving clients from ad-hoc trades onto a standing hedging policy they run every month
* Statements, notifications and review moments that build the habit and prove the value after the fact

**Experimentation & Measurement**

* A cadence of A/B tests across the journey, not a feature backlog
* Reading results honestly, including the ones that kill your own ideas
* Building the measurement so conversion, and what's driving it

**What success looks like (12-18 months)**

* Spot-to-hedger conversion rate is measurably higher, and you can attribute the lift
* A meaningful share of new hedgers convert through product journeys rather than a CPM conversation
* CPMs work from exposure signals in a tool instead of instinct and spreadsheets, and cover more clients as a result
* Clients can articulate their own FX exposure — and clients who hedge once come back without being called
* More hedgers move onto hedging policies rather than trading ad hoc
* Product — not people — becomes the primary driver of hedging conversion

**What makes this role hard**

* You're changing behaviour, not shipping features. The instrument already exists and works; the reason more clients don't use it is understanding, trust and habit.
* It's a two-sided problem. Clients and CPMs need different views of the same truth, and building for one badly makes the other worse but the CPMs must know what the client can see to have consultative conversations
* The baseline isn't zero. There's an existing business and an existing way of converting clients, you have to improve on it without disrupting it.
* Exposure is genuinely hard to model. Client data is incomplete, trade history is a proxy for intent, and being confidently wrong about someone's exposure destroys trust instantly.
* You're helping non-experts make decisions with real financial consequences. Oversimplify and you mislead; don't simplify and nobody acts.
* You'll navigate real-world complexity: regional and regulatory nuance, credit and margin implications, and client segments with genuinely different needs.

**Who we are looking for**

Prior FX or hedging experience is a plus, not a requirement. We're looking for someone who can move a hard conversion number in a complex, regulated environment — with strong agency, sharp analytical instincts, and a real feel for why people do and don't act.

**Must-have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including at least one role owning conversion, adoption or engagement outcomes end-to-end
* Strong analytics and experimentation skills — funnel analysis, cohort and retention analysis, designing and interpreting A/B tests
* Experience designing lifecycle journeys or triggered workflows, and the messaging that carries them
* Fluent English (daily collaboration with global commercial, tech and Legal/Compliance/Risk stakeholders)

**Nice-to-have:**

* Familiarity with foreign exchange, hedging or other asset classes
* Experience in fintech or regulated financial products
* Experience building internal or advisor-facing tooling alongside client-facing product
* Localisation awareness

**Core Capabilities**

* **Strong Product Fundamentals** — breaks down ambiguous problems into clear product opportunities; comfortable working across UX, data and operations; focused on outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Funnel & Journey Thinking** — instinctively looks for where clients fall out and why; designs staged journeys rather than isolated features; sizes the opportunity before designing the fix.
* **Two-Sided Design** — builds for clients and the internal teams serving them at once; understands the trade-offs between automation and human judgement.
* **Behavioural Instinct** — thinks in triggers, incentives and habit loops; understands that conversion is earned, not shipped.
* **Analytical Depth** — partners with Data rather than outsourcing the thinking; can build the exposure and funnel view themselves and defend it.
* **Commercial Awareness** — understands how product decisions land in revenue and margin; prioritises on business impact, not just user feedback.
* **High Agency & Pragmatism** — comfortable operating in under-defined environments; bias to action; doesn't wait for perfect structure.
* **Deep Customer Curiosity** — regularly speaks to clients and CPMs; uses it to inform decisions, not just validate them.

**Why Ebury?**

* **Competitive Starting Salary** with an **annual discretionary bonus**that truly rewards your performance from day one.
* **Dedicated Mentorship:** Learn directly from experienced managers who are invested in your success.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage state-of-the-art tailor made tools and systems that enable you to perform at your best.
* **Clear, Accelerated Career Progression:** Defined pathways to leadership and specialist roles within Ebury.
* **Dynamic & Supportive Culture:** Work in a collaborative environment where teamwork and personal growth are prioritized.
* **Generous Benefits Package:** Access competitive benefits tailored to your location, which typically include health care and social benefits.
* **Central** **Madrid** **Office: A fantastic location with excellent transport links.**

  

**Ready to launch your career with a global FinTech? Click the 'Apply' Today and discover your potential at Ebury!**

You can also connect with me on LinkedIn - Fabienne Zigrit

  

#LI-FZ1

#LI-HYBRID

**About us**

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we're always looking to add to our team.

title: Managing Tech Lead - Europa Universalis V
description:
You will join the studio as the manager of our technical team working on a live grand strategy game, together with the designers, artists and QA who build and test it. We are looking for a Managing Tech Lead to lead the team and keep the existing codebase healthy: maintaining it, improving it and making sure it keeps supporting the game as it grows.

We care about how the team works: clear technical goals, honest conversations about priorities, and people who grow. If you enjoy helping engineers do their best work, and still want to stay close enough to the craft to make good calls, this is a good place for that.

Here the leads plan, decide and build. Judgment and hands-on work go together. Stay close to the code, develop your leadership skills and make great games.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Manage the programming team: one-to-ones, feedback, career development, performance, hiring and onboarding.
* Set clear technical objectives for the team that support the creative vision and the product roadmap, and contribute to technical direction alongside the other leads.
* Drive improvements to the game and the existing codebase, with a focus on performance, stability and maintainability.
* Work with the other managers to remove blockers, keep production moving and balance technical decisions against scope, schedule and budget.
* Keep the team's work aligned with the roadmap across concurrent update branches, so that we build and release with as few technical setbacks as possible.
* Stay connected to Paradox's wider technical organization, so that practices, tools and knowledge flow in both directions.
* Time permitting, contribute hands-on: implementing features and systems, reviewing code and solving gameplay problems with efficient technical solutions.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Solid C++ experience in a professional setting, ideally in games, including at least one shipped or live title.
* Experience leading a team of programmers, including the people side: setting expectations, giving feedback, and having the difficult conversations.
* Technical judgment: you prioritize under real constraints, make trade-offs and own the call.
* The ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-engineers alike.
* A history of improving how a team works. There is a practice, tool or workflow that exists, or was killed, because of you.
* Clear, direct communication in English, written and spoken.

**Things to elevate your application**
--------------------------------------

* Paradox grand strategy experience, Europa Universalis especially. Genuine interest in the genre matters more than logged hours.
* Experience on a live title with a recurring update cadence.
* Experience working with a large, long-lived codebase.

**The Studio**
--------------

Paradox Tinto was founded in 2020 by a small and dedicated team of industry veterans led by Johan Andersson, and building on our experience from Paradox Interactive and Paradox Development Studio, we develop Europa Universalis V, the latest entry in the grand strategy franchise that started it all more than twenty-five years ago.

**The Team**
------------

At Paradox Tinto we work in a small, gameplay focused team, where everyone is part of crafting the player experience and has input on the design of the game. We believe game development should be fun, and we strive for a relaxed, stress-free atmosphere. Being a small studio built from the ground up, we expect everyone to contribute to the development of the studio and its culture. We are also proud of having accessible, experienced managers who lead you and care about you. Your contributions matter to us, to the whole studio, and to the games we make. You will be close to the final product, our community and our fans. We will encourage you to interact with our players directly through social media, our forum, and via streams. Work/life balance matters to us, so our development plans do not rely on crunch. This does not mean we never work overtime, but overtime is relatively uncommon and not encouraged.

**The Location**
----------------

Our office is 300m from one of the beaches of Sitges, a picturesque Mediterranean coastal city. It is well connected by public transport and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, pharmacies, supermarkets, shops and hotels. Sitges is barely 20 minutes by car or bus from El Prat, Barcelona's international airport. It offers 17 beaches along its own coastline, the Costa del Garraf, and an average of 300 days of sun a year, which is hard to argue with for outdoor sports and weekends. Mountain lovers still have the Pyrenees, only a two hour drive away. The town will also captivate you with its cultural events, Mediterranean food and, of course, excellent Spanish wine.

* Private health insurance
* Wellhub subscription: gym access and digital wellbeing apps
* A private gym at the office, plus optional free yoga and HIIT sessions
* Cobee by Pluxee flexible compensation, letting you allocate part of your gross salary to meals or public transport
* Free access to the full Paradox catalogue on Steam, over 100 games
* Healthy snacks and soft drinks, a private garden, and regular team activities

If you think this description matches you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we interview candidates continuously. If you don't match all the requirements, tell us how your passion, attitude and interest in Paradox might compensate.

At Paradox Interactive we celebrate difference and care deeply about diversity and inclusion. We therefore encourage you, no matter who you are, to apply for this job if you think you'd be a great addition to our team.

title: Director, EMEA Regional Marketing
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Talkdesk is seeking a strategic, commercially minded **Director of EMEA Regional Marketing** to lead regional marketing strategy, execution, and business impact across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

This leader will serve as a key strategic partner to EMEA sales leadership, translating regional business priorities, market opportunities, and customer insights into integrated marketing strategies that build awareness, create demand, deepen account engagement, and accelerate pipeline.

As part of the global Growth Marketing organization, the Director will connect global marketing strategy with regional market needs, orchestrating campaigns, account-based marketing (ABM), digital, partner, customer, and experiential programs to deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, brings a strong understanding of enterprise B2B marketing, and thrives in a matrixed, cross-functional environment. This individual will be equally comfortable advising regional sales leadership, developing market-specific growth plans, and leading teams to deliver high-impact marketing programs.

**Success in this role will be measured not by the volume of marketing activities delivered, but by their contribution to regional growth, account engagement, pipeline development, and revenue outcomes.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Regional Strategy & Business Alignment**

* Own the development and execution of an integrated EMEA regional marketing strategy aligned to global marketing priorities, regional business objectives, and revenue goals.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to EMEA sales leadership, developing a deep understanding of regional priorities, market dynamics, customer segments, and growth opportunities.
* Translate business objectives into actionable regional marketing plans that support market development, demand creation, pipeline generation, and deal acceleration.
* Identify and prioritize marketing investments across EMEA markets based on business potential, account opportunity, sales capacity, and expected impact.
* Bring regional market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive perspectives into global marketing planning and investment decisions.

### **Integrated Demand Generation & Account Engagement**

* Lead the regional activation of integrated marketing programs across digital, ABM, content, partner, customer, and experiential channels.
* Partner with global Campaigns, ABM, Digital, and Marketing Operations teams to translate global programs into relevant, high-impact regional initiatives.
* Develop targeted engagement strategies for priority industries, strategic accounts, and high-value opportunities in partnership with sales and account teams.
* Drive marketing programs across the customer journey, from awareness and demand creation to opportunity progression, pipeline acceleration, and customer expansion.
* Ensure regional marketing activities deliver coordinated, meaningful engagement with buying groups and key decision-makers.
* Evaluate and deploy the most effective mix of marketing channels, programs, and experiences to achieve defined business outcomes.

### **Sales, Partner & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Establish strong, trusted relationships with regional sales leaders, account executives, business development teams, and other go-to-market stakeholders.
* Lead collaborative planning with sales to establish shared priorities, target accounts, engagement strategies, and measurable success criteria.
* Partner with global marketing functions, including Campaigns, ABM, Digital, Product Marketing, Corporate Marketing, and Marketing Operations, to ensure alignment and maximize the impact of regional investments.
* Collaborate with partner and alliance marketing stakeholders to integrate ecosystem opportunities into regional growth plans, including co-marketing and joint demand-generation initiatives.
* Facilitate clear communication, accountability, and coordination across regional and global teams to deliver a cohesive go-to-market experience.

### **Performance, Investment & Optimization**

* Own regional marketing planning, budget management, investment prioritization, and performance optimization.
* Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks aligned to regional business objectives, including account engagement, pipeline creation, pipeline influence, opportunity progression, and marketing ROI.
* Leverage CRM, marketing automation, intent, engagement, and performance data to identify opportunities, optimize investments, and improve program effectiveness.
* Provide regular, actionable insights to regional sales and global marketing leadership, connecting marketing performance to business outcomes.
* Continuously evaluate marketing investments, reallocating resources toward the programs, channels, and markets delivering the greatest impact.

### **Team Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Lead, coach, and develop regional marketing talent, fostering a culture of strategic thinking, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear roles, priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for the regional marketing team.
* Build scalable, repeatable processes that improve marketing effectiveness while allowing for necessary regional and market-level flexibility.
* Champion a business-first, outcome-oriented marketing mindset that prioritizes strategic impact over activity volume.
* Navigate a matrixed global organization effectively, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving alignment without relying solely on direct reporting relationships.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required Experience & Skills**

* 8–10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional marketing, integrated demand generation, account-based marketing, or related growth marketing disciplines.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing regional marketing strategies that contribute to pipeline creation, opportunity acceleration, and revenue growth.
* Strong understanding of enterprise B2B go-to-market models, complex buying journeys, and multi-stakeholder account engagement.
* Experience partnering directly with senior sales leadership to develop joint business plans, align priorities, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proven ability to orchestrate integrated marketing programs across multiple channels and global marketing functions.
* Experience working across EMEA markets, with an appreciation for regional differences, customer behaviors, market maturity, and local go-to-market requirements.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate marketing and sales data into actionable investment decisions.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, prioritizing resources, and demonstrating return on marketing investment.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, including developing talent, managing teams, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, ABM, and marketing performance technologies.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud technology, customer experience, or contact center technology.
* Experience supporting multiple EMEA subregions and coordinating marketing efforts across diverse markets.
* Familiarity with partner-led and ecosystem-based go-to-market strategies.
* Experience operating within a centralized global marketing organization and matrixed regional sales structure.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Willingness to travel within EMEA and internationally as business needs require.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The Director, EMEA Regional Marketing will establish marketing as a proactive, strategic growth partner to the regional business.

Success will be demonstrated through:

* **Strategic alignment:** Clear, prioritized regional marketing plans jointly developed with sales and connected to global growth priorities.
* **Meaningful account engagement:** Increased reach, engagement, and buying-group penetration across strategic accounts and priority market segments.
* **Pipeline contribution:** Measurable marketing impact on pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.
* **Integrated execution:** Effective activation of global marketing programs through coordinated regional, account, digital, partner, and customer engagement strategies.
* **Investment effectiveness:** Data-driven allocation of resources toward high-impact programs and measurable business returns.
* **Organizational leadership:** A high-performing regional marketing team recognized for commercial acumen, proactive collaboration, and accountability.

**This role is an opportunity to shape how regional marketing contributes to enterprise growth—moving beyond tactical execution to become a strategic driver of market opportunity, customer engagement, and revenue performance.**

title: Head of Performance Creative

Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).

* High-Tempo Work Ethic (50+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 50+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.

At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Director of Brand & Communications
description:
A
**profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote**
is looking for a
**Head of Brand & Community**
to join our team! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.
  
  
We are looking for someone who has
**done it before**
and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has
**7+ years**
in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.
  
  
**The mission of this role**
Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.
  
  
**Who are we?**
We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space - $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
  
  
**What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**
Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
  
  

* Better Everyday: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better
* Speed Is King: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule
* Work Smart: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data
* Overdeliver: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.**
If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active - then you've come to the right place.
  
  
**Outcomes (what Success Looks Like)**
*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* More people know and search for our brands: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
* More new customers come from word of mouth and press: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
* We earn press and attention: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
* Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
* The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social

**Key Objectives**

* Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct
* Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact
* Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press
* Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal
* Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage
* Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content
* Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget

**Requirements**

* Fully remote, full-time, based in Mexico, Ukraine or Brazil
* Fluent in English
* Brand Experience: 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5-6 years with strong results is also considered
* Brand Builder: You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage
* Brand Moments: You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners
* Cause Marketing: You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page
* PR & Storytelling: You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it
* North America: You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors
* Brand Taste: A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint
* Commercial Mindset: You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder
* Bonus points: pet industry experience

**Accountabilities**
*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* Brand foundation and guidelines: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint
* Cause and shelter partnerships: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact
* Brand moments and activations: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams
* PR and earned media: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention
* Community and customer stories: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly
* Brand reporting and budget: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person

**How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

* Application + Screening Interview
* In-Depth Interview with the CEO
* Reference Calls
* Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

**Salary Expectation**
**US$45,000-70,000 base per year**
(based on experience and expertise), plus a bonus of 10-20% of base.

**Job Description**
Location: 100% Remote
  
  
Compensation: Competitive salary, based on experience
  
  
Schedule: Full-Time (40 hrs/week)
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
You will work with M&P Partners.
  
  
We are looking for a highly creative, tech-expert Marketing Manager to take our companies and brands to the next level. You will be the hands-on "doer" working directly under our Marketing Lead, turning ideas into finished content, campaigns and creatives across our portfolio of brands, starting with a medical aesthetics brand, then expanding to a consulting business and the founder's personal brand.
  
  
We already have a large library of existing content. A big part of this role is getting creative with what we already have: repurposing, editing, packaging and publishing it so it performs. This is not a strategy-only seat. We need someone who gets their hands dirty, is very creative, and also gets a lot done.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Content Creation: Create new content from our existing content library (short-form video, reels, carousels, posts, graphics) for each brand
* Posting & Channel Management: Schedule, publish and manage content across social channels (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and others as needed)
* Email Marketing: Write and build emails and campaigns. The Marketing Lead provides ideation and final review; you own the writing, building and execution
* Ad & Marketing Creatives: Come up with and produce creatives for paid ads and marketing campaigns (statics, video concepts, hooks, copy)
* Content Production Management: Manage the content pipeline end to end, making sure raw footage gets to editors, edits get done on time, and quality is maintained
* Tech & Tools: Own the marketing tech stack: scheduling tools, design and editing software, email platforms, CRMs and AI tools. Set things up, troubleshoot and keep them running
* AI Integration: Use AI tools to scale output (copy, scripts, image and video assets) without sacrificing brand voice
* Multi-Brand Execution: Start with the medical aesthetics brand, then expand the same system to the consulting business and the founder's personal brand
* Reporting: Track what's working (engagement, reach, email and ad metrics) and share short weekly updates with the Marketing Lead

TIME & LOCATION
  
  

* Full-Time (40 hrs/week), with an immediate start upon hire
* 100% remote. You will need a quiet workspace with fast internet, a webcam and a microphone for video calls
* Must be able to accommodate different schedules and time zones

**Requirements**
WHAT YOU NEED
  
  

* Very Creative: A strong eye for content, design and hooks. You can look at existing footage and see five new pieces of content

title: Head Of Product UX And Design Product Owners Experience And Creative
description:
**Job Description**
Company Description
  
  
Our Client is a real estate developer creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, with an intelligent agent that learns its occupants and adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity. Their approach is built around the idea that a smart home should know you, care for you and make you healthier over time, not just act as a remote control on an app.
  
  
Our Client runs a lab and experience centre where products are tested with real residents and office users, and has a pipeline of thousands of units to deploy into. Our Client is a fast-moving, founder-led organisation, with a mandate to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional Head of Product, UX & Design to own what our client builds and how it feels. The client is creating AI-native, agentic homes and workplaces, spaces with an intelligent agent that learns their occupants and continuously adapts the environment toward wellness and longevity.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer (CAIO), you will lead all product owners, product managers, designers and creative talent. You will turn the CAIO’s vision into clear product roadmaps and an unmistakably premium experience across every touchpoint: the super app, wall switches, smart mirrors, voice, a 3D AI agent, and the physical spaces themselves.
  
  
We are looking for a design superhero with product leadership depth: someone of the calibre found at Apple, Uber, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut or leading health-tech companies. You must hold a very high bar, and be confident enough to push back when something isn’t good enough.
  
  
Reporting & Team
  
  
Reports to: Chief AI Officer (CAIO)
  
  
Key partners: Head of Technology (engineering delivery); Technical Program Manager; Marketing & Brand (including external brand agencies); Sales & Go-to-Market
  
  
**Leads:**

* Product owners: Agentic Intelligence, PWA / Super App, Hardware & IoT. Each owns their product end to end and partners day to day with the Head of Technology’s engineering teams.
* Product management: Product Managers and Product Associates reporting into each product owner
* UX Design: UX Design Manager, Product Designers, UX/UI Designers
* Creative & Graphics: Graphic Design Manager, Senior Graphic Designer, Motion Graphics Designer

Key Responsibilities Requirements
  
  

* Product Leadership & Roadmap
* Own the product strategy and roadmap across the client’s three product lines: the agentic intelligence layer, the PWA / super app, and the hardware & IoT experience.
* Lead and grow the product owners, giving each a clear mandate, outcomes and accountability for delivering a complete, working product with their engineering counterparts.
* Turn the CAIO’s vision into prioritised, sequenced roadmaps that balance residential first (the current priority), commercial workplaces, and later hospitality.
* Define success metrics and run the product cadence (discovery, PRDs, sprint reviews, launch readiness) together with the Technical Program Manager.
* The Super App & Customer Journey
* Own the end-to-end journey in the PWA, evolving it into the super app for agentic living:

+ Pre-sales: an AI-guided digital brochure, delivered through brokers, that helps buyers choose an apartment and its customisations.
+ Onboarding: the resident “interviews” their home agent, building their profile, preferences and household setup (with privacy between family members).
+ Handover: construction updates, fit-out choices and move-in readiness.
+ Living: daily control and wellness insights, plus communicating with the home from anywhere.

* Design for multiple modalities (chat, voice, a 3D/avatar agent and touch) while keeping the experience simple for people who don’t want to “talk to AI”.
* UX, Interaction & Design Systems
* Build and own the design system across app, web, wall switches, smart mirrors, tablets and in-space displays.
* Define the interaction language for ambient, mostly invisible automation: how the space shows what it is doing, what it detected, and how the occupant can override it.
* Champion research and usability testing with real residents and office users in the lab and Experience Centre.
* Set and protect a world-class quality bar for micro-interactions, motion and polish.
* Creative Direction & Brand Expression
* Lead the creative and graphics team: visual design, motion graphics, product storyboards and sales/marketing assets.
* Partner with Marketing and the brand agency so that the brand direction (bold and colourful, “Nike meets Apple”, glassmorphism and neumorphism, biophilic cues) shows up consistently in the product.
* Produce product vision videos and prototypes that make an invisible, passive experience visible and compelling to investors, buyers and partners.
* Wellness, Data & Trust
* Translate biometric and wellness data (from wearables such as Whoop, Oura and Ultrahuman, and from in-space sensing) into insights and nudges people actually act on, without being creepy.
* Make privacy and consent a first-class part of the experience, working with the Head of Technology on privacy-by-design.

Product & Design Leadership Requirements
  
  

* Product Leadership: Product strategy, roadmapping, OKRs, managing product owners/managers, outcome-based prioritisation
* UX & Interaction: Multi-platform UX (mobile, web/PWA, embedded displays), conversational and voice UX, prototyping, user research
* Visual & Creative: Design systems, typography, motion design, brand-to-product translation; strong portfolio required
* AI Product Literacy: Understanding of LLMs and agents, and how to design trustworthy, explainable AI experiences
* Tooling: Figma (expert), prototyping tools (ProtoPie, Framer or similar), After Effects/motion tooling, analytics platforms
* Collaboration: Proven partnership with engineering leadership; experience working with external agencies
* Leadership: Built and led combined product + design teams of 10+; hiring and mentoring across seniority levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hardware-Adjacent Products: Experience designing products that extend beyond the screen into smart home, IoT, wearables, automotive or connected devices.
* Health/Wellness Tech: Product or design leadership at a health-tech or wearables company (e.g. Whoop, Oura, Ultrahuman, Eight Sleep) is a strong plus.
* Consumer Super Apps: Experience at companies known for design excellence and complex consumer journeys (e.g. Apple, Uber, Careem, Noon, Swiggy, Revolut).
* Zero-to-One Experience: You have built a product and a team from scratch, not just optimised an existing one.
* Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: You will push back on a bad idea, including the CEO’s, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

Why This Role?
  
  
Most real-estate “smart homes” are a remote control on an app. Our client is building something different: homes and workplaces that know you, care for you and make you healthier over time. You will define the face, voice and feel of that intelligence, from the first time a buyer meets the client’s agent on a broker’s tablet to the moment a resident’s bathroom mirror suggests a better night’s sleep. You will have the mandate, the team and the executive support to set a new design standard for the industry.
  
  
Additional Suggestions for the Candidate
  
  

* Portfolio Is Everything: Please include case studies that show product thinking and craft, ideally including motion and multi-device work.
* Think Beyond the Screen: Come ready to discuss how you would design an experience where the best interaction is often no interaction at all.
* Bring a Point of View: Tell us one thing you would change about how today’s smart home apps work, and how you would do it better.
* Offered Salary: Competitive, in line with market standards for the role and seniority, along with additional benefits as per the company’s band structure.
